description: Exodus with real Sanskrit and Sumerian words mixed
note: Real Sanskrit and Sumerian vocabulary mixed in sentences

verses.text: now these are sa names ak bi children asya israel, ša gin antar egypt; every lú u3 tasya household è ù jacob.
reuben, simeon, levi, ù judah,
issachar, zebulun, ca benjamin,
dan, u3 naphtali, gad, u3 asher.
ù niĝ sa souls tad ā-gam bar ak bi loins ak jacob gál seventy souls: arthạm joseph me a egypt already.
u3 joseph died, ca sarva tasya brethren, api šu ne generation.
ù bi children ak israel me fruitful, api increased abundantly, u3 multiplied, ca waxed exceeding mighty; api sa bhū as filled saha bi-ne.
now atra arose up a new rāja over egypt, yad knew na joseph.
ca bi vac šè ani saĝ, behold, sa loka ak bi children sya israel are more ù mightier than we:

āyā on, dā us deal wisely sahita tān; lest they multiply, u3 idam è prati pass, yad, when atra falleth bāhya any war, they join also prati our enemies, u3 fight against us, api nu-me get etān up bahis sya bi pradeśa.
therefore they did set over tān taskmasters šè afflict bi-ne ù teṣām burdens. u3 they built kṛte pharaoh treasure cities, pithom ù raamses.
but bi more they afflicted bi-ne, bi more they multiplied u3 grew. u3 they bhū grieved because ak bi children ak israel.
ca eṣa egyptians nirmā eṣa children ak israel prati serve saha rigour:
tathā they vidh eṣām lives bitter da hard bondage, a morter, ca ša brick, u3 ša sarva manner ak service a eṣa field: šu bi-meš service, wherein they gag bi-ne serve, me da rigour.
ù bi rāja ak egypt spake abhimukham sa hebrew midwives, sya yad bi name ak bi diš bhū shiphrah, ù sa name ak bi other puah:

tathā ayam kathay, when ye do tad office ak a midwife abhimukham sa hebrew women, u3 lok bi-ne ugu bi stools; if idam vṛt a ātmaja, then ye shall kill him: but if bi gál a daughter, then she shall til.
but sa midwives feared an, ca did na as bi lugal ak egypt commanded bi-ne, but saved eṣa men children alive.
api bi ensi sya egypt āhva kṛte tad midwives, tathā dug4 abhimukham bi-ne, why have ye done bi thing, u3 have saved sa men children alive?
u3 bi midwives e prati pharaoh, because tad hebrew women are nu as bi egyptian women; kṛte they are lively, ù are delivered ere sa midwives prāp madhye abhimukham bi-ne.
therefore īśvara dealt well sahita bi midwives: api sa loka multiplied, ca waxed very mighty.
tathā ne du prati pass, because bi midwives feared deva, tad ani vidh bi-ne houses.
ù pharaoh charged šu tasya prajā, inim, every ibila iri is born ye shall cast šè bi river, u3 every daughter ye shall save alive.
ù atra gam a manuṣya asya eṣa geh asya levi, u3 took šè wife a daughter sya levi.
u3 bi dam conceived, tathā bare a suta: u3 when she dṛś him yad bi gál a goodly child, she hid him three months.
u3 when she could ul longer hide him, she took kṛte him an ark ak bulrushes, tathā daubed tat da slime tathā saha pitch, u3 put sa child therein; ù she laid ne antar tad flags by sa river's brink.
tathā ani sister stood afar off, abhimukham wit what would as done abhimukham him.
u3 bi daughter sya pharaoh prāp down šè wash herself at bi river; ù ani-munus maidens walked along by bi river's side; ù when she igi-du8 bi ark among bi flags, she sent tasyāḥ maid šè fetch ne.
ù when she had opened idam, she dṛś bi child: ca, behold, eṣa babe wept. tathā she had compassion on him, api e, bi is eka asya bi hebrews' children.
then vac ani sister abhimukham pharaoh's daughter, shall i è ù gu3-dé šè thee a nurse ak bi hebrew women, ne she may nurse bi child arthạm thee?
ù pharaoh's daughter e abhimukham asyāḥ, gen. ca eṣa maid gam api gu3-dé eṣa child's mother.
api pharaoh's daughter inim abhimukham ani-munus, take ne child away, tathā nurse idam šè me, u3 i will give thee thy wages. u3 bi strī took eṣa child, ù nursed tat.
ca bi child grew, api she brought him abhimukham pharaoh's daughter, u3 ani became asyāḥ dumu. u3 she nam tasya name moses: ù she vac, because i drew him bar ak eṣa ídim.
u3 bi ā-gam šè pass antar those days, when moses me grown, iri ani gen bahis prati tasya brethren, u3 looked on bi-meš burdens: u3 ani spied an egyptian smiting an hebrew, diš ak tasya brethren.
tathā sa looked bi way u3 tad way, ca when bi dṛś iri tatra gál nu puruṣa, bi slew eṣa egyptian, ca hid him ša bi sand.
api when bi yā bar sa dvitīya u4, behold, min men sya bi hebrews strove saṃyuktam: api ayam e šè him iri did bi wrong, wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
ca ani brū, who dim thee a prince ca a judge over us? intendest thou abhimukham kill me, as thou killedst sa egyptian? u3 moses feared, api e, surely bi thing is known.
now when pharaoh heard bi thing, sa sought šè slay moses. but moses fled ta bi mukha ak pharaoh, tathā dwelt antar tad kur ak midian: ù bi sat down by a well.
now sa priest ak midian had seven daughters: ù they gin api drew udaka, api filled bi troughs šè jala eṣām father's flock.
tathā eṣa shepherds gin ca drove etān away: but moses stood up u3 helped bi-ne, ù watered bi-meš flock.
ù when they è abhimukham reuel bi-meš father, bi inim, how is bi ne ye are du ittham soon prati dina?
tathā they vac, an egyptian delivered us è asya tad hand asya sa shepherds, api also drew a enough kṛte us, ù watered tad flock.
ù sa kathay šè ani daughters, u3 where is bi? why is tat iri ye have left sa nitadam? āhva him, iri ayam may eat bread.
u3 moses gál content prati dwell sahita tad lú: ù ayam gave moses zipporah bi daughter.
api she bare him a ibila, tathā eṣa nam asya name gershom: kṛte ayam vac, i have me a stranger ša a strange pradeśa.

ù tat gin abhimukham pass ša process ak time, iri tad lugal sya egypt died: api bi children ak israel sighed by reason sya bi bondage, tathā they cried, ca teṣām cry du up šè ilum by reason ak sa bondage.
u3 dingir heard bi-meš groaning, u3 an remembered asya covenant da abraham, sahita isaac, tathā da jacob.
api bhagavān looked par bi children asya israel, ù deva had respect šè bi-ne.
now moses kept bi flock sya jethro bi father madhye law, bi priest asya midian: u3 ani led eṣa flock abhimukham bi backside asya bi desert, ca āyā šè eṣa mountain asya bhagavān, even prati horeb.
u3 tad angel ak sa nātha appeared šè him madhye a flame sya fire bar ak bi murgu ak a bush: ù ani looked, tathā, behold, sa bush burned saha fire, tathā bi bush gál nu consumed.
ù moses kathay, i will now turn aside, ca igi etat mahā sight, why bi bush is na burnt.
ù when eṣa nātha igi-du8 yad ayam turned aside prati dṛś, deva hve šè him è sya tad murgu sya eṣa bush, u3 e, moses, moses. u3 ani brū, here am i.
u3 ani vac, draw mā nigh hither: put off thy shoes tas off thy feet, arthạm bi deśa whereon thou standest is holy ground.
moreover ani inim, i am eṣa an sya thy father, tad deva asya abraham, bi dingir sya isaac, api bi bhagavān sya jacob. tathā moses hid ani pa; arthạm sa bhū afraid prati look šu-ba deva.
u3 bi prabhu inim, i have surely igi-du8 sa affliction sya my saĝ lú are madhye egypt, u3 have heard bi-meš cry by reason ak teṣām taskmasters; kṛte i know teṣām sorrows;

ù i am āyā down šè deliver bi-ne bāhya asya sa hand sya bi egyptians, u3 šè bring etān up bāhya ak ne kur abhimukham a śubha bhū ca a large, prati a pradeśa flowing da milk ù honey; šè tad deśa asya bi canaanites, ù sa hittites, u3 bi amorites, u3 bi perizzites, ca sa hivites, ù tad jebusites.
now therefore, behold, eṣa cry asya eṣa children sya israel is du abhimukham me: tathā i have also bar bi oppression wherewith bi egyptians oppress etān.
du now therefore, ca i will send thee šè pharaoh, iri thou mayest bring forth my loka tad children sya israel bāhya sya egypt.
u3 moses dug4 prati bhagavān, who am i, tad i should gam šè pharaoh, tathā tad i should bring forth bi children ak israel bāhya ak egypt?
ù eṣa vac, certainly i will bhū sahita thee; api ne shall me a token abhimukham thee, yad i have sent thee: when thou hast brought forth tad saĝ è ak egypt, ye shall serve bhagavān upari ne mountain.

api moses kathay šè ilum, behold, when i gin prati bi children sya israel, ù shall brū prati etān, eṣa an sya your fathers hath sent me šè you; ù they shall vac šè me, what is asya name? what shall i brū šè etān?
ù an kathay prati moses, i am ne i am: ù eṣa kathay, thus shalt thou e šè bi children asya israel, i am hath sent me šè you.

tathā bhagavān kathay moreover prati moses, thus shalt thou kathay prati bi children ak israel, bi svāmin bhagavān ak your fathers, tad bhagavān asya abraham, bi īśvara sya isaac, api bi dingir asya jacob, hath sent me prati you: etat is my name šè ever, u3 ne is my memorial šè sarva generations.

yā, ù gar sa elders sya israel niĝin, api e šè etān, eṣa ensi dingir ak your fathers, tad īśvara ak abraham, ak isaac, ca ak jacob, appeared šè me, e, i have surely visited you, ca dṛś yad ša is done šè you antar egypt:

tathā i have kathay, i will bring you up bar sya bi affliction asya egypt šè bi kur ak eṣa canaanites, u3 bi hittites, api sa amorites, u3 sa perizzites, u3 bi hivites, u3 bi jebusites, šè a kalam flowing ù milk ù honey.

ù they shall hearken prati thy voice: ù thou shalt prāp, thou ca eṣa elders ak israel, prati bi lugal sya egypt, api ye shall dug4 prati him, eṣa nātha deva ak sa hebrews hath met da us: u3 now he-me us gen, we beseech thee, three days' journey praviśya bi wilderness, ne we may sacrifice šè eṣa lugal our deva.
ù i am sure tad bi bhūpati sya egypt will ul dā you gen, nu, nu by a mighty hand.
u3 i will stretch è my hand, api smite egypt ù šu my wonders yad i will do madhye sa šà thereof: api after iri ani will he-me you du.
ca i will give etat ùĝ favour ša bi sight ak bi egyptians: api ne shall è šè pass, ne, when ye du, ye shall na vraj empty:

but every sal shall borrow sya ani-munus neighbour, ca ak ani-munus ne sojourneth a ani-munus ki-gal, jewels ak silver, ù jewels ak gold, api raiment: u3 ye shall put bi-ne ugu your ibila, u3 šu-ba your daughters; ù ye shall spoil eṣa egyptians.
u3 moses answered api kathay, but, behold, they will ul believe me, nor hearken šè my voice: šè they will kathay, sa lugal hath ul appeared prati thee.
ù eṣa ensi kathay šè him, what is tad ša thine hand? u3 ani brū, a rod.
ca ayam e, cast ne on bi ground. ca ani cast ne on bi ground, ù bi became a serpent; ca moses fled ta before idam.
u3 tad lugal vac šè moses, put forth thine hand, u3 take tat by bi tail. api eṣa put forth ani hand, ca caught bi, ca ne became a rod ša bi hand:
tad they may believe iri tad lugal bhagavān sya bi-meš fathers, sa deva ak abraham, sa īśvara ak isaac, ù eṣa dingir asya jacob, hath appeared abhimukham thee.
u3 eṣa en e furthermore prati him, put now thine hand a thy bosom. u3 ani put tasya hand praviśya ani bosom: ù when bi took ne è, behold, tasya hand bhū leprous as snow.
tathā ayam dug4, put thine hand šè thy bosom again. ù sa put tasya hand antar ani bosom again; ca plucked bi bar asya tasya bosom, ca, behold, ne as turned again as asya other flesh.
ù ne shall du prati pass, if they will na believe thee, neither hearken abhimukham bi voice ak eṣa ādya sign, tad they will believe bi voice ak sa latter sign.

ca ne shall āyā prati pass, if they will ul believe also these dvi signs, neither hearken prati thy voice, yad thou shalt take sya eṣa ídim ak tad river, api pour ne šu-ba bi śuṣka deśa: u3 bi ídim ša thou takest è sya eṣa river shall become blood par sa nirjala kur.
ù moses inim prati sa svāmin, o my svāmin, i am na eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken šè thy servant: but i am slow ak speech, tathā sya a slow tongue.
api bi lugal vac šè him, who hath dù man's mouth? or who maketh bi dumb, or deaf, or bi seeing, or bi blind? have nu i eṣa lugal?
now therefore gen, api i will gál da thy mouth, tathā teach thee what thou shalt inim.
tathā ani inim, o my nātha, send, i pray thee, by bi hand ak him whom thou wilt send.

ca bi anger ak bi svāmin gál kindled against moses, ca ani inim, is ul aaron eṣa levite thy brother? i know tad ani can speak well. ca also, behold, ani cometh forth šè meet thee: ca when bi seeth thee, ani will vṛt glad antar bi heart.
api thou shalt speak abhimukham him, ca put words a ani mouth: tathā i will me ù thy mouth, tathā da ani mouth, u3 will teach you what ye shall do.
tathā ani shall gál thy spokesman šè bi prajā: api ayam shall me, even eṣa shall gál prati thee instead sya a mouth, u3 thou shalt bhū šè him instead ak ilum.
tathā thou shalt take bi rod antar thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

api moses gen api returned abhimukham jethro ani father antar law, u3 brū šè him, he-me me gen, i pray thee, ca return prati my brethren yaḥ are ša egypt, u3 lok whether they vṛt yet alive. api jethro vac abhimukham moses, du antar peace.
tathā bi ensi e šè moses a midian, gam, return praviśya egypt: mu niĝ bi men are dead yaḥ sought thy ti.
ù moses took ani wife u3 asya putra, ù set tān upari an ass, u3 ayam returned šè bi deśa ak egypt: ù moses took bi rod asya dingir ša tasya hand.

u3 bi lugal vac prati moses, when thou goest šè return šè egypt, paś iri thou do gištug those wonders before pharaoh, yad i have put antar thine hand: but i will harden ani heart, yad sa shall ul he-me eṣa saĝ gen.
api thou shalt vac prati pharaoh, thus saith eṣa lugal, israel is my ibila, even my firstborn:
ca i kathay abhimukham thee, gá my suta du, tad sa may serve me: ca if thou refuse šè anujñā him gam, behold, i will slay thy ātmaja, even thy firstborn.
ù tat gin šè pass by bi way madhye bi inn, ne sa svāmin met him, api sought abhimukham kill him.
then zipporah took a sharp stone, ù cut off bi foreskin ak asyāḥ suta, ù cast idam at asya feet, tathā e, surely a bloody husband art thou abhimukham me.
ittham sa gá him gam: then she vac, a bloody husband thou art, because asya bi circumcision.
ca sa nātha brū abhimukham aaron, du a sa wilderness prati meet moses. api ani vraj, ù met him antar tad mount ak bhagavān, ù kissed him.
ù moses told aaron gištug bi words ak bi lugal who had sent him, api šu eṣa signs yaḥ ani had commanded him.
tathā moses ca aaron è u3 sañcay ús niĝ bi elders ak sa children asya israel:
ù aaron spake gištug bi words yaḥ eṣa svāmin had spoken prati moses, u3 did bi signs madhye sa sight asya sa jana.
tathā bi loka believed: api when they heard ne bi ensi had visited bi children asya israel, ù yad bi had looked par eṣām affliction, then they bowed bi-meš heads tathā worshipped.
ù afterward moses ù aaron è a, u3 told pharaoh, thus saith bi svāmin an sya israel, anujñā my jana è, yad they may hold a feast šè me ša sa wilderness.
api pharaoh kathay, who is bi en, iri i should obey ani voice abhimukham dā israel gen? i know nu eṣa ensi, neither will i anujñā israel è.

ca they dug4, bi īśvara ak tad hebrews hath met ù us: he-me us è, we pray thee, three days' journey praviśya sa desert, ù sacrifice šè eṣa nātha our bhagavān; lest bi fall šu-ba us da pestilence, or sahita bi sword.
ca bi lugal asya egypt kathay šè etān, wherefore do ye, moses ca aaron, he-me bi loka ta teṣām works? get you abhimukham your burdens.
tathā pharaoh vac, behold, sa jana asya bi kalam now are many, u3 ye vidh bi-ne rest prabhṛti bi-meš burdens.
u3 pharaoh commanded sa same ud sa taskmasters sya bi jana, api eṣām officers, vac,
ye shall nahi more give eṣa ùĝ straw šè nirmā brick, as heretofore: gá bi-ne yā u3 saṃgṛh straw arthạm themselves.
api bi tale ak eṣa bricks, ša they did dù heretofore, ye shall lay ugu bi-ne; ye shall ul diminish ought thereof: šè they me idle; therefore they cry, e, gá us gen tathā sacrifice prati our ilum.
he-me ne more work me laid upari tad men, yad they may labour therein; u3 gá bi-ne ul regard vain words.
ù tad taskmasters ak tad ùĝ gen bāhya, u3 bi-meš officers, api they spake prati sa prajā, dug4, thus saith pharaoh, i will nu give you straw.
gen ye, get you straw where ye can find tat: yet mā ought ak your work shall bhū diminished.
ittham bi saĝ me scattered abroad throughout niĝ eṣa deśa ak egypt šè sañcay stubble instead sya straw.
ù bi taskmasters hasted etān, inim, fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when tatra vṛt straw.

api bi officers sya tad children asya israel, yaḥ pharaoh's taskmasters had set over etān, me beaten, tathā demanded, wherefore have ye nu fulfilled your task ša making brick both yesterday u3 abhimukham dina, as heretofore?
then sa officers sya sa children sya israel du ù cried šè pharaoh, vac, wherefore dealest thou thus sahita thy servants?
tatra is nu straw given šè thy servants, u3 they e abhimukham us, dim brick: ca, behold, thy servants are beaten; but bi fault is a thine own ùĝ.
but ani dug4, ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye brū, gá us vraj u3 do sacrifice abhimukham bi nātha.
gam therefore now, u3 work; arthạm tatra shall nu straw gál given you, yet shall ye deliver eṣa tale ak bricks.
ca sa officers ak bi children ak israel did igi-du8 tad they bhū ša evil case, after ne as vac, ye shall nu minish ought ta your bricks ak your daily task.
ù they met moses u3 aaron, who stood a bi way, as they ā-gam forth tas pharaoh:

api they brū prati tān, tad svāmin look šu-ba you, ù judge; because ye have dim our savour šè me abhorred a bi eyes ak pharaoh, ù a bi eyes sya bi servants, abhimukham put a sword antar bi-meš hand prati slay us.
u3 moses returned prati bi ensi, ù dug4, ensi, wherefore hast thou evam evil entreated etat saĝ? why is idam tad thou hast sent me?
arthạm since i du abhimukham pharaoh prati speak antar thy name, bi hath done evil šè ne ùĝ; neither hast thou delivered thy ukkin at viśva.
then bi ensi dug4 šè moses, now shalt thou bar what i will do prati pharaoh: kṛte da a strong hand shall bi anujñā etān gam, api sahita a strong hand shall ayam drive bi-ne è ak bi bhū.
ca dingir spake šè moses, u3 kathay prati him, i am bi lugal:
u3 i appeared šè abraham, šè isaac, api abhimukham jacob, by bi name ak deva almighty, but by my name jehovah bhū i ul known šè tān.
api i have also established my covenant da bi-ne, šè give bi-ne sa deśa asya canaan, sa bhū asya eṣām pilgrimage, wherein they bhū strangers.
ù i have also heard bi groaning asya bi children ak israel, whom bi egyptians keep ša bondage; ù i have remembered my covenant.

wherefore inim prati bi children sya israel, i am tad en, u3 i will bring you bar prabhṛti ki-ta bi burdens ak sa egyptians, tathā i will rid you bāhya ak bi-meš bondage, ù i will redeem you saha a stretched bar arm, ù saha gu-la judgments:
api i will take you abhimukham me mu a loka, u3 i will vṛt šè you a an: ca ye shall know ne i am bi svāmin your an, yaḥ bringeth you bāhya ta kur bi burdens ak tad egyptians.
u3 i will bring you madhye šè bi deśa, concerning eṣa ša i did swear prati give tat šè abraham, šè isaac, api abhimukham jacob; ù i will give idam you mu an heritage: i am eṣa nātha.
u3 moses spake ga-nam šè bi children asya israel: but they hearkened ul abhimukham moses šè anguish asya ātman, ca kṛte cruel bondage.
ca bi lugal spake šè moses, brū,
gen ša, speak abhimukham pharaoh nṛpa ak egypt, ne bi dā eṣa children asya israel vraj è asya ani pradeśa.
ù moses spake before eṣa ensi, e, behold, eṣa children asya israel have nu hearkened abhimukham me; how then shall pharaoh hear me, who am sya uncircumcised lips?
api tad svāmin spake šè moses u3 šè aaron, u3 gave bi-ne a charge šè sa children ak israel, ca prati pharaoh ensi ak egypt, šè bring bi children ak israel è sya tad deśa sya egypt.
these bhū sa heads ak teṣām fathers' houses: sa ibila sya reuben tad firstborn sya israel; hanoch, u3 pallu, hezron, ca carmi: these gál eṣa families asya reuben.
api bi ātmaja ak simeon; jemuel, ca jamin, u3 ohad, u3 jachin, api zohar, ù shaul tad putra ak a canaanitish munus: these are bi families ak simeon.
ù these are sa names sya bi ātmaja ak levi according prati eṣām generations; gershon, u3 kohath, tathā merari: u3 eṣa years ak bi prāṇa ak levi as an hundred thirty u3 seven years.
eṣa ātmaja ak gershon; libni, ù shimi, according šè teṣām families.
ù bi dumu ak kohath; amram, u3 izhar, tathā hebron, u3 uzziel: u3 bi years ak bi ti ak kohath as an hundred thirty ù three years.
ù tad ibila sya merari; mahali ù mushi: these are sa families ak levi according šè eṣām generations.
ù amram took him jochebed tasya father's sister abhimukham wife; ù she bare him aaron api moses: api eṣa years asya sa āyus ak amram me an hundred ù thirty u3 seven years.
u3 sa ātmaja sya izhar; korah, ù nepheg, ù zichri.
ca tad ibila ak uzziel; mishael, api elzaphan, ù zithri.
api aaron took him elisheba, daughter ak amminadab, sister ak naashon, šè wife; api she bare him nadab, ù abihu, eleazar, ù ithamar.
ù bi putra ak korah; assir, tathā elkanah, ù abiasaph: these are bi families ak bi korhites.
ù eleazar aaron's ātmaja took him aš asya bi daughters ak putiel prati wife; u3 she bare him phinehas: these are bi heads sya eṣa fathers asya bi levites according prati eṣām families.
these are ne aaron u3 moses, šè whom bi nātha e, bring bāhya tad children ak israel ta sa kur ak egypt according šè bi-meš armies.
these are they yad spake šè pharaoh rāja ak egypt, šè bring è bi children ak israel ta egypt: these are tad moses u3 aaron.
ù ne āyā šè pass on bi u4 when bi lugal spake šè moses antar bi bhū asya egypt,
yad sa ensi spake šè moses, e, i am bi svāmin: speak thou šè pharaoh lugal asya egypt šu tad i inim šè thee.
ù moses inim before tad prabhu, behold, i am asya uncircumcised lips, tathā how shall pharaoh hearken prati me?
tathā bi en brū abhimukham moses, paś, i have dim thee a an abhimukham pharaoh: api aaron thy brother shall as thy prophet.
thou shalt speak sarva tad i command thee: u3 aaron thy brother shall speak šè pharaoh, yad bi send bi children ak israel bāhya ak ani kur.
u3 i will harden pharaoh's heart, tathā multiply my signs api my wonders madhye eṣa kur ak egypt.
but pharaoh shall na hearken šè you, iri i may lay my hand ugu egypt, u3 bring forth mine armies, tathā my jana bi children ak israel, bāhya ak bi pradeśa ak egypt by mah judgments.
u3 bi egyptians shall know iri i am eṣa en, when i stretch forth mine hand ugu egypt, u3 bring è bi children sya israel tas among bi-ne.
ca moses u3 aaron did as tad ensi commanded bi-ne, nu-me did they.
u3 moses gál fourscore years old, ù aaron fourscore ù three years old, when they spake prati pharaoh.
ù bi ensi spake abhimukham moses ù šè aaron, vac,
when pharaoh shall speak prati you, inim, shew a miracle šè you: then thou shalt kathay prati aaron, take thy rod, ù cast ne before pharaoh, u3 tat shall become a serpent.
u3 moses u3 aaron gam antar prati pharaoh, u3 they did ittham as bi nātha had commanded: u3 aaron cast down tasya rod before pharaoh, ù before ani servants, ca ne became a serpent.
then pharaoh also āhva tad wise men api sa sorcerers: now sa magicians asya egypt, they also did madhye like manner ù bi-meš enchantments.
kṛte they cast down every lú asya rod, u3 they became serpents: but aaron's rod swallowed up bi-meš rods.
u3 bi hardened pharaoh's heart, tad ani hearkened mā abhimukham etān; as bi nātha had inim.
api tad ensi vac prati moses, pharaoh's heart is hardened, ayam refuseth šè anujñā eṣa jana gam.

get thee prati pharaoh madhye bi uṣas; lo, bi goeth bahis abhimukham eṣa udaka; ca thou shalt stand by tad river's brink against sa ā-gam; u3 bi rod yad vṛt turned šè a serpent shalt thou take ša thine hand.
ca thou shalt vac prati him, sa lugal īśvara sya sa hebrews hath sent me prati thee, brū, dā my loka gen, tad they may serve me a eṣa wilderness: u3, behold, hitherto thou wouldest na hear.
thus saith eṣa svāmin, ša ne thou shalt know tad i am bi svāmin: behold, i will smite ù eṣa rod tad is a mine hand upari bi a lú are madhye tad river, tathā they shall vṛt turned šè blood.
tathā sa fish tad is antar bi river shall úš, tathā sa river shall stink; ù bi egyptians shall lothe abhimukham drink asya tad udaka sya bi river.

ca eṣa lugal spake šè moses, kathay prati aaron, take thy rod, api stretch bāhya thine hand par tad ap ak egypt, par bi-meš streams, upari teṣām rivers, api upari eṣām ponds, api upari gištug bi-meš pools ak ap, tad they may become blood; api tad tatra may as blood throughout sarva sa kalam asya egypt, both antar vessels asya wood, ca antar vessels sya stone.

tathā moses ù aaron did nu-me, as bi svāmin commanded; ca bi lifted up bi rod, api smote bi a yad as antar bi river, ša bi sight ak pharaoh, api a tad sight ak bi servants; ca šu tad a iri as antar sa river me turned šè blood.
ca tad fish iri bhū a sa river died; u3 bi river stank, u3 tad egyptians could na drink sya bi ídim ak eṣa river; ù atra gál blood throughout sarva bi kalam asya egypt.
api bi magicians asya egypt did nu-me da bi-meš enchantments: tathā pharaoh's heart me hardened, neither did ani hearken abhimukham bi-ne; as bi ensi had inim.
ù pharaoh turned u3 yā a tasya é, neither did sa set asya heart abhimukham ne also.
u3 šu bi egyptians digged round about bi river arthạm ap šè drink; šè they could na drink ak sa jala ak bi river.
ù seven days bhū fulfilled, after iri eṣa svāmin had smitten bi river.
tathā bi svāmin spake šè moses, du abhimukham pharaoh, tathā e prati him, thus saith bi ensi, anujñā my ùĝ gen, tad they may serve me.
ù if thou refuse prati dā tān vraj, behold, i will smite viśva thy borders da frogs:

ca eṣa river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, ša shall du up ca āyā a thine gṛha, ù šè thy bedchamber, ca šu-ba thy bed, api a tad gṛha asya thy servants, ù šu-ba thy loka, tathā šè thine ovens, ù antar thy kneadingtroughs:
api tad frogs shall du up both on thee, ù par thy ùĝ, api par viśva thy servants.
u3 eṣa en spake abhimukham moses, dug4 abhimukham aaron, stretch forth thine hand ù thy rod over bi streams, over tad rivers, ca over eṣa ponds, u3 cause frogs šè è up upari bi bhū ak egypt.
tathā aaron stretched è asya hand over bi udaka asya egypt; u3 eṣa frogs prāp up, ca covered bi pradeśa asya egypt.
u3 bi magicians did ittham da bi-meš enchantments, ù brought up frogs par tad kalam sya egypt.
then pharaoh hve šè moses tathā aaron, tathā vac, intreat bi nātha, tad eṣa may take away tad frogs tas me, u3 ta my jana; ù i will anujñā bi saĝ yā, yad they may do sacrifice šè eṣa ensi.

u3 moses e abhimukham pharaoh, glory over me: when shall i intreat arthạm thee, ù kṛte thy servants, ca mu thy ukkin, šè destroy tad frogs prabhṛti thee u3 thy houses, ne they may remain a sa river only?
u3 sa vac, prati morrow. ca bi vac, bhū tat according abhimukham thy word: iri thou mayest know yad ne is none like abhimukham bi lugal our ilum.
ca eṣa frogs shall depart tas thee, u3 tas thy houses, ca prabhṛti thy servants, u3 ta thy ùĝ; they shall remain antar eṣa river only.
u3 moses api aaron gen è ta pharaoh: ù moses cried abhimukham bi nātha because ak sa frogs yad bi had brought against pharaoh.
tathā bi lugal did according abhimukham bi word ak moses; ù eṣa frogs died bar sya sa houses, bar sya eṣa villages, u3 bāhya ak bi fields.
u3 they šum tān niĝin ugu heaps: ca tad kalam stank.
but when pharaoh bar yad ni me respite, bi hardened bi heart, api hearkened nu abhimukham tān; as bi svāmin had kathay.
u3 eṣa nātha e šè moses, inim prati aaron, stretch è thy rod, ù smite eṣa dust sya eṣa kur, tad idam may become lice throughout sarva tad pradeśa sya egypt.

tathā they did ittham; arthạm aaron stretched bar ani hand sahita tasya rod, ca smote bi dust ak tad dharā, u3 idam became lice antar nara, ca madhye beast; viśva eṣa dust ak bi bhū became lice throughout sarva bi kur sya egypt.
api eṣa magicians did ga-nam da eṣām enchantments šè bring forth lice, but they could mā: ga-nam tatra gál lice upari nitadam, u3 upari beast.
then tad magicians inim šè pharaoh, bi is bi finger ak deva: u3 pharaoh's heart vṛt hardened, ù bi hearkened ul prati bi-ne; as tad lugal had brū.
u3 bi ensi dug4 prati moses, rise up early a sa uṣas, ca stand before pharaoh; lo, bi cometh forth šè eṣa a; ù e šè him, thus saith tad prabhu, gá my ùĝ gam, iri they may serve me.

else, if thou wilt mā he-me my prajā è, behold, i will send swarms asya flies šu-ba thee, tathā ugu thy servants, ù par thy saĝ, ù praviśya thy houses: ù sa houses asya tad egyptians shall me full sya swarms ak flies, u3 also eṣa ground whereon they are.
tathā i will sever a yad dina bi kur sya goshen, a lú my saĝ dwell, iri na swarms ak flies shall bhū atra; šè eṣa end thou mayest know yad i am bi en a bi šà ak sa ki.
tathā i will put a division between my ùĝ api thy saĝ: šè morrow shall idam sign gál.

u3 sa en did evam; ù ne du a grievous swarm asya flies antar eṣa ki-gal sya pharaoh, tathā a ani servants' houses, ù praviśya niĝ tad kalam ak egypt: sa bhū as corrupted by reason ak sa swarm ak flies.
u3 pharaoh mu-ù šè moses ù šè aaron, u3 brū, du ye, sacrifice prati your bhagavān a tad kalam.

ù moses dug4, bi is na meet ga-nam šè do; arthạm we shall sacrifice bi abomination sya bi egyptians šè bi ensi our an: lo, shall we sacrifice bi abomination ak bi egyptians before bi-meš eyes, tathā will they mā stone us?
we will vraj three days' journey a tad wilderness, api sacrifice šè eṣa lugal our īśvara, as eṣa shall command us.
ù pharaoh e, i will dā you gen, iri ye may sacrifice šè eṣa lugal your deva madhye bi wilderness; only ye shall mā gam very far away: intreat arthạm me.

ù moses inim, behold, i vraj bahis ta thee, ù i will intreat sa ensi ne bi swarms sya flies may depart ta pharaoh, tas bi servants, api prabhṛti tasya ùĝ, šè morrow: but he-me nu pharaoh deal deceitfully any more madhye na letting bi saĝ gam šè sacrifice prati sa svāmin.
api moses du bahis prabhṛti pharaoh, api intreated tad lugal.
ù eṣa svāmin did according abhimukham eṣa word ak moses; ca bi removed bi swarms ak flies tas pharaoh, tas bi servants, api prabhṛti ani prajā; atra remained nu eka.
ù pharaoh hardened bi heart at bi time also, neither would bi anujñā bi ùĝ du.
then bi svāmin vac prati moses, è a šè pharaoh, tathā tell him, thus saith bi prabhu ilum ak tad hebrews, dā my loka è, yad they may serve me.
kṛte if thou refuse šè dā etān yā, ca wilt hold etān still,
behold, bi hand ak bi svāmin is ugu thy cattle yaḥ is a eṣa field, par sa horses, upari eṣa asses, šu-ba eṣa camels, šu-ba bi oxen, u3 upari bi sheep: ne shall gál a very grievous murrain.
u3 tad nātha shall sever between bi cattle ak israel u3 sa cattle sya egypt: api tatra shall nothing kāl sya sarva ne is eṣa children's ak israel.
u3 bi svāmin appointed a set time, e, šè morrow eṣa ensi shall do bi thing madhye tad kur.
ù bi svāmin did ne thing on bi morrow, ù viśva bi cattle ak egypt died: but ak sa cattle sya tad children sya israel died na aš.
u3 pharaoh sent, ù, behold, ni me na eka ak bi cattle asya eṣa israelites dead. u3 eṣa heart ak pharaoh vṛt hardened, u3 bi did nu gá bi loka vraj.
ù eṣa en e prati moses api šè aaron, take šè you handfuls sya ashes ak bi furnace, u3 dā moses sprinkle ne toward bi dyau a bi sight asya pharaoh.
ca tat shall become small dust a sakala bi bhū ak egypt, api shall me a boil breaking forth saha blains upari lú, ù par beast, throughout sarva bi kur ak egypt.
tathā they took ashes asya bi furnace, api stood before pharaoh; u3 moses sprinkled bi up toward svarga; tathā idam became a boil breaking forth sahita blains šu-ba nara, tathā šu-ba beast.
ù bi magicians could mā stand before moses because ak eṣa boils; arthạm bi boil gál ugu tad magicians, u3 par niĝ sa egyptians.
tathā eṣa nātha hardened tad heart ak pharaoh, ù eṣa hearkened ul šè tān; as bi lugal had spoken šè moses.
api bi lugal brū abhimukham moses, rise up early ša bi u4-zal, ù stand before pharaoh, ù dug4 prati him, thus saith bi en īśvara asya tad hebrews, anujñā my ukkin vraj, iri they may serve me.
šè i will at ne time send niĝ my plagues ugu thine heart, tathā šu-ba thy servants, api šu-ba thy saĝ; yad thou mayest know yad ni is none like me antar niĝ bi uraš.
arthạm now i will stretch bahis my hand, iri i may smite thee ù thy ùĝ da pestilence; u3 thou shalt me cut off prabhṛti bi ki.
api antar very deed arthạm etat cause have i raised thee up, arthạm abhimukham shew madhye thee my power; tathā iri my name may gál declared throughout sakala sa dharā.
as yet exaltest thou thyself against my ukkin, tad thou wilt mā anujñā bi-ne du?
behold, šè morrow about ne time i will cause bi prati rain a very grievous hail, such as hath nu bhū antar egypt since tad foundation thereof even until now.

send therefore now, ù saṃgṛh thy cattle, ca gištug tad thou hast antar sa field; kṛte ugu every manuṣya tathā beast yaḥ shall me found madhye eṣa field, tathā shall na me brought home, bi hail shall du down ugu bi-ne, api they shall ug7.
ani ne feared eṣa word ak bi lugal among bi servants ak pharaoh gag bi servants ù bi cattle flee a sa houses:
api ani tad regarded ul bi word ak tad lugal left tasya servants ù tasya cattle madhye bi field.

u3 tad lugal brū abhimukham moses, stretch forth thine hand toward dyau, iri tatra may bhū hail a niĝ tad deśa ak egypt, par nara, u3 upari beast, api upari every herb asya tad field, throughout sa kur asya egypt.
api moses stretched forth ani rod toward anu: tathā bi prabhu sent thunder u3 hail, u3 bi fire ran along upari tad ground; api bi lugal rained hail ugu sa kalam ak egypt.
ga-nam ni gál hail, u3 fire mingled ù bi hail, very grievous, such as ne me none like bi antar sarva eṣa deśa ak egypt since ne became a nation.
ù tad hail smote throughout šu sa kalam ak egypt niĝ ne vṛt antar sa field, both lú u3 beast; ù bi hail smote every herb ak bi field, api brake every tree sya tad field.
only ša tad bhū ak goshen, where sa children sya israel gál, bhū ni nu hail.
ca pharaoh sent, ù āhva kṛte moses ca aaron, ca kathay abhimukham etān, i have sinned idam time: sa lugal is righteous, tathā i ù my ùĝ are wicked.
intreat bi prabhu (for ne is enough) ne ne bhū nahi more mighty thunderings ù hail; u3 i will gá you gam, ù ye shall stay nahi longer.

ù moses kathay prati him, as soon as i am gone bahis ak tad city, i will spread abroad my hands šè bi nātha; ù bi thunder shall cease, neither shall tatra gál any more hail; yad thou mayest know how iri bi pṛthivī is bi lord's.
but as kṛte thee tathā thy servants, i know yad ye will ul yet fear tad prabhu ilum.
u3 sa flax u3 sa barley vṛt smitten: šè tad barley me antar sa ear, tathā bi flax as bolled.
but bi wheat api bi rie bhū mā smitten: kṛte they gál nu grown up.
ù moses du bāhya ak bi city prabhṛti pharaoh, ù spread abroad bi hands šè eṣa prabhu: ù tad thunders ù hail ceased, ù tad rain gál mā poured upari tad uraš.
tathā when pharaoh lok yad sa rain tathā tad hail u3 bi thunders vṛt ceased, ani sinned yet more, tathā hardened asya heart, ayam api asya servants.
u3 sa heart asya pharaoh me hardened, neither would bi anujñā sa children sya israel du; as sa svāmin had spoken by moses.
ù sa nātha vac šè moses, gen a abhimukham pharaoh: kṛte i have hardened ani heart, ù sa heart asya tasya servants, ne i might shew these my signs before him:
ù tad thou mayest tell antar eṣa ears sya thy dumu, ù asya thy son's putra, what things i have wrought antar egypt, ù my signs yaḥ i have done among tān; iri ye may know how ne i am bi nātha.
u3 moses tathā aaron è a šè pharaoh, ca brū prati him, thus saith bi svāmin dingir sya sa hebrews, how long wilt thou refuse abhimukham humble thyself before me? gá my saĝ yā, yad they may serve me.
else, if thou refuse šè he-me my ukkin vraj, behold, abhimukham morrow will i bring sa locusts šè thy coast:

u3 they shall cover bi mukha sya eṣa dharā, ne aš cannot as able šè paś sa dharā: ca they shall eat bi residue sya iri ša is escaped, ša remaineth abhimukham you ta sa hail, tathā shall eat every tree ša groweth šè you bar ak tad field:

ù they shall fill thy houses, ca bi houses sya niĝ thy servants, ca bi houses sya sakala eṣa egyptians; yad neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have dṛś, since bi u4 tad they bhū par bi pṛthivī šè ne ud. api sa turned himself, ca è bahis ta pharaoh.
ca pharaoh's servants e šè him, how long shall ne puruṣa gál a snare prati us? gá sa men du, yad they may serve eṣa prabhu bi-meš dingir: knowest thou ul yet yad egypt is destroyed?
u3 moses u3 aaron as brought again abhimukham pharaoh: api ani brū abhimukham bi-ne, du, serve bi svāmin your an: but who are they ne shall è?
tathā moses kathay, we will yā da our young tathā sahita our old, saha our ibila tathā ù our daughters, sahita our flocks ù saha our herds will we gen; mu we must hold a feast abhimukham eṣa lugal.
u3 eṣa kathay abhimukham etān, gá tad lugal bhū ittham saha you, as i will anujñā you gen, u3 your little ones: look šè tat; mu evil is before you.
mā evam: vraj now ye ne are men, ù serve sa nātha; šè tad ye did desire. u3 they as driven è ta pharaoh's presence.

ca eṣa en dug4 abhimukham moses, stretch è thine hand over bi kalam sya egypt kṛte bi locusts, tad they may gin up ugu bi bhū ak egypt, ca eat every herb ak bi kur, even gištug yad eṣa hail hath left.
ca moses stretched forth tasya rod over sa pradeśa asya egypt, ù eṣa prabhu brought an east wind šu-ba bi kalam viśva iri ud, ca šu yad ge6; ù when idam vṛt uṣas, sa east wind brought bi locusts.
u3 bi locusts è up over sarva tad kalam sya egypt, u3 rested ša niĝ bi coasts ak egypt: very grievous as they; before bi-ne tatra vṛt nu such locusts as they, neither after etān shall vṛt such.

arthạm they covered sa vadana sya bi whole kalam, ittham ne bi kur gál darkened; ù they did eat every herb ak eṣa pradeśa, api šu bi fruit sya eṣa trees lú tad hail had left: u3 tatra remained ul any green thing a bi trees, or ša bi herbs ak bi field, through šu sa kalam asya egypt.
then pharaoh gu3-dé šè moses ca aaron a haste; u3 sa inim, i have sinned against tad nātha your an, api against you.
now therefore forgive, i pray thee, my sin only idam once, u3 intreat sa lugal your bhagavān, iri ayam may take away ta me bi ug7 only.
ù eṣa vraj bāhya tas pharaoh, api intreated bi en.
u3 eṣa en turned a mighty strong west wind, ša took away bi locusts, ca cast bi-ne antar bi red sea; atra remained nu prathama locust antar gištug eṣa coasts ak egypt.
but tad lugal hardened pharaoh's heart, ittham tad ani would nu gá bi children sya israel yā.
ù tad svāmin dug4 šè moses, stretch è thine hand toward an, tad atra may as andhakāra over eṣa kalam ak egypt, even andhakāra lú may gál felt.
ca moses stretched forth bi hand toward svarga; api atra gál a thick gi6 ša sarva bi kur asya egypt three days:
they lok mā prathama another, neither rose any tas tasya ki šè three days: but gištug sa children ak israel had jyotis antar eṣām dwellings.
u3 pharaoh āhva šè moses, ca vac, du ye, serve bi ensi; only gá your flocks ù your herds gál stayed: he-me your little ones also yā ù you.
ù moses e, thou must give us also sacrifices tathā burnt offerings, tad we may sacrifice šè sa ensi our an.

our cattle also shall gam da us; ne shall ul an hoof me left behind; mu thereof must we take abhimukham serve bi ensi our bhagavān; api we know ul da what we must serve bi lugal, until we āyā thither.
but sa lugal hardened pharaoh's heart, u3 ani would ul gá bi-ne gam.
api pharaoh brū šè him, get thee prabhṛti me, take heed prati thyself, paś my pa nu more; šè a yad ahar thou seest my vadana thou shalt pralī.
api moses e, thou hast spoken well, i will igi-du8 thy vadana again na more.

ca tad lugal kathay šè moses, yet will i bring prathama plague more ugu pharaoh, tathā ugu egypt; afterwards ayam will dā you gen hence: when ani shall anujñā you du, ani shall surely thrust you è hence altogether.
speak now antar tad ears sya bi saĝ, ca anujñā every nitadam borrow ak bi neighbour, ù every nārī ak ani-munus neighbour, jewels ak silver, api jewels ak gold.
api bi en gave bi loka favour madhye eṣa sight ak sa egyptians. moreover sa guruš moses bhū very viśāla ša eṣa deśa sya egypt, antar bi sight ak pharaoh's servants, api antar bi sight ak tad saĝ.
api moses inim, thus saith bi prabhu, about midnight will i gam bāhya praviśya eṣa madhya ak egypt:

ù niĝ eṣa firstborn madhye bi kur sya egypt shall mṛ, tas eṣa 1-kam born sya pharaoh tad sitteth šu-ba tasya throne, even šè bi firstborn asya bi maidservant ne is behind bi mill; u3 šu bi firstborn sya beasts.
api atra shall me a viśāla cry throughout šu sa bhū sya egypt, such as tatra vṛt none like bi, nor shall gál like bi any more.
but against any sya bi children ak israel shall ul a dog du tasya tongue, against lú or beast: tad ye may know how tad bi nātha doth put a difference between tad egyptians ù israel.

ca sakala these thy servants shall è down abhimukham me, api bow down themselves šè me, vac, get thee è, api viśva tad ùĝ tad follow thee: u3 after iri i will yā bar. api ani du bar prabhṛti pharaoh antar a mahā anger.
tathā bi en kathay prati moses, pharaoh shall mā hearken prati you; iri my wonders may me multiplied ša bi kalam asya egypt.
ca moses u3 aaron did šu these wonders before pharaoh: ù bi prabhu hardened pharaoh's heart, ittham iri sa would na dā bi children ak israel è bahis sya bi kur.
u3 bi svāmin spake šè moses api aaron ša eṣa deśa sya egypt, e,
ne month shall me prati you bi sag sya months: tat shall as bi ādya month ak eṣa year abhimukham you.

speak ye šè sarva bi congregation ak israel, inim, madhye bi tenth ahar ak idam month they shall take abhimukham tān every puruṣa a lamb, according abhimukham bi é asya eṣām fathers, a lamb šè an sadana:

api if eṣa household gál too little šè bi lamb, dā him u3 ani neighbour next abhimukham asya ki-gal take tat according prati bi number sya bi souls; every guruš according šè bi eating shall dù your count mu bi lamb.
your lamb shall bhū rahita blemish, a male sya sa prathama year: ye shall take idam bahis prabhṛti tad sheep, or ta tad goats:
u3 ye shall keep tat up until bi fourteenth u4 ak sa same month: api bi whole assembly ak tad congregation asya israel shall kill tat madhye sa murgu.
u3 they shall take ak eṣa blood, ù strike ne on sa dvau side posts tathā on bi upper door post ak eṣa houses, wherein they shall eat bi.
ca they shall eat eṣa flesh madhye tad rājani, roast saha fire, api unleavened bread; tathā da bitter herbs they shall eat idam.
eat ul sya tat raw, nor sodden at sakala ù ap, but roast saha fire; tasya head ù bi legs, u3 da bi purtenance thereof.
ca ye shall gá nothing ak tat remain until sa u4-zal; ù iri yaḥ remaineth ak idam until eṣa u4-ul-li ye shall burn ù fire.
api thus shall ye eat idam; da your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, tathā your staff a your hand; ù ye shall eat ne a haste: bi is bi lord's passover.

kṛte i will pass through sa kalam asya egypt bi rājani, tathā will smite gištug bi firstborn madhye bi deśa ak egypt, both puruṣa tathā beast; ca against sarva eṣa gods sya egypt i will execute judgment: i am bi nātha.

u3 bi blood shall bhū šè you kṛte a token upari tad houses where ye are: ù when i lok sa blood, i will pass over you, ù eṣa plague shall ul gál upari you prati destroy you, when i smite eṣa kur ak egypt.
api etat ud shall me abhimukham you šè a memorial; ù ye shall keep tat a feast prati bi ensi throughout your generations; ye shall keep idam a feast by an ordinance kṛte ever.

seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even bi prathama u4 ye shall put away leaven bar asya your houses: šè whosoever eateth leavened bread prabhṛti bi 1-kam ud until bi seventh ud, tad soul shall as cut off tas israel.

tathā a bi prathama divasa ne shall gál an holy convocation, tathā antar bi seventh divasa ne shall vṛt an holy convocation prati you; na manner ak work shall gál done a bi-ne, save tad ša every puruṣa must eat, ne only may gál done sya you.

ù ye shall observe bi feast ak unleavened bread; kṛte ša idam selfsame dina have i brought your armies bāhya asya bi kalam ak egypt: therefore shall ye observe bi ud ša your generations by an ordinance šè ever.
madhye bi 1-kam month, on eṣa fourteenth dina ak bi month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until bi aš api twentieth ud ak sa month at even.

seven days shall ne gál nu leaven found ša your houses: šè whosoever eateth yad ša is leavened, even tad soul shall gál cut off ta tad congregation ak israel, whether sa vṛt a stranger, or born ša bi bhū.
ye shall eat nothing leavened; madhye sarva your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
then moses āhva kṛte sarva bi elders ak israel, u3 brū šè bi-ne, draw bar u3 take you a lamb according abhimukham your families, api kill sa passover.

ù ye shall take a bunch ak hyssop, ca dip bi a eṣa blood yad is antar tad bason, u3 strike tad lintel tathā sa min side posts da sa blood iri is madhye bi bason; ca none asya you shall gam bāhya at eṣa door ak bi geh until bi u4-ul-li.

kṛte bi en will pass through prati smite tad egyptians; u3 when ani seeth tad blood šu-ba eṣa lintel, u3 on eṣa min side posts, bi nātha will pass over tad door, tathā will na suffer bi destroyer prati è ša abhimukham your houses šè smite you.
u3 ye shall observe bi thing kṛte an ordinance šè thee tathā šè thy ibila kṛte ever.
tathā idam shall prāp prati pass, when ye gál è šè bi kur yaḥ eṣa svāmin will give you, according as ayam hath promised, tad ye shall keep etat service.
tathā tat shall du abhimukham pass, when your children shall dug4 šè you, what mean ye by etat service?

iri ye shall brū, ne is sa sacrifice asya bi lord's passover, who passed over bi houses ak eṣa children asya israel madhye egypt, when eṣa smote tad egyptians, tathā delivered our houses. api bi loka bowed bi head tathā worshipped.
ù sa children sya israel è away, ca did as bi nātha had commanded moses tathā aaron, ittham did they.

ca idam du prati pass, tad at midnight tad prabhu smote sarva bi firstborn ša tad kalam sya egypt, prabhṛti bi firstborn ak pharaoh tad sat on ani throne abhimukham bi firstborn ak tad captive ne me madhye bi dungeon; tathā niĝ bi firstborn ak cattle.
ù pharaoh rose up antar eṣa niśā, eṣa, api niĝ bi servants, u3 sakala sa egyptians; api atra gál a gu-la cry antar egypt; kṛte tatra me na a é where tatra gál na eka dead.
tathā ani hve kṛte moses tathā aaron by rājani, api vac, rise up, u3 get you forth prabhṛti among my prajā, both ye ù bi children ak israel; api du, serve bi ensi, as ye have dug4.
also take your flocks ca your herds, as ye have kathay, tathā vṛt gone; tathā bless me also.
tathā bi egyptians me urgent par sa ùĝ, iri they might send etān bar ak bi kalam ša haste; arthạm they brū, we me šu dead men.
api sa prajā took eṣām dough before bi as leavened, eṣām kneadingtroughs being bound up antar bi-meš clothes upari bi-meš shoulders.
ù sa children asya israel did according šè bi word ak moses; ù they borrowed ak eṣa egyptians jewels ak silver, ù jewels asya gold, u3 raiment:
tathā eṣa nātha gave sa ùĝ favour ša bi sight ak eṣa egyptians, ga-nam tad they lent šè etān such things as they required. u3 they spoiled sa egyptians.
ca bi children asya israel journeyed tas rameses prati succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot iri gál men, beside children.
api a mixed multitude vraj up also saha bi-ne; tathā flocks, ù herds, even very much cattle.

ca they baked unleavened cakes ak bi dough ša they brought forth bar sya egypt, arthạm bi gál ul leavened; because they bhū thrust è ak egypt, api could mā tarry, neither had they prepared kṛte themselves any victual.
now bi sojourning ak bi children ak israel, who dwelt a egypt, gál four hundred tathā thirty years.
u3 tat āyā šè pass at bi end ak bi four hundred api thirty years, even bi selfsame divasa ne ā-gam abhimukham pass, tad sarva bi hosts ak bi lugal gam bar tas sa pradeśa ak egypt.
ne is a gi6 šè gál much observed prati bi en šè bringing tān è prabhṛti bi bhū asya egypt: etat is tad rātri ak bi en prati gál observed ak šu bi children asya israel madhye bi-meš generations.
api eṣa ensi dug4 šè moses api aaron, idam is bi ordinance ak eṣa passover: tatra shall nu stranger eat thereof:
but every man's servant ne is bought arthạm money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall ani eat thereof.
a foreigner u3 an hired servant shall mā eat thereof.
antar prathama é shall ne gál eaten; thou shalt mā carry forth ought ak bi flesh abroad bar asya bi geh; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
gištug sa congregation sya israel shall keep bi.

ù when a stranger shall sojourn sahita thee, ù will keep bi passover prati sa ensi, anujñā gištug tasya males me circumcised, u3 then he-me him gin near u3 keep tat; u3 bi shall gál as eka iri is born madhye eṣa kalam: šè nahi uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
prathama law shall me šè him yad is homeborn, u3 abhimukham bi stranger tad sojourneth among you.
thus did niĝ bi children asya israel; as tad en commanded moses u3 aaron, ga-nam did they.
u3 idam è šè pass bi selfsame ud, yad bi lugal did bring tad children ak israel è ak sa kur ak egypt by bi-meš armies.
ù eṣa nātha spake abhimukham moses, kathay,
sanctify šè me niĝ bi firstborn, whatsoever openeth eṣa womb among eṣa children ak israel, both sya puruṣa u3 ak beast: ne is mine.

tathā moses inim šè tad jana, remember idam ud, a yad ye gin è ta egypt, bar ak sa é ak bondage; mu by strength asya hand tad svāmin brought you bahis ta ne sthāna: atra shall nu leavened bread me eaten.
idam ud gin ye bahis ša tad month abib.

ù bi shall vṛt when bi en shall bring thee antar eṣa kalam asya bi canaanites, ca bi hittites, ca tad amorites, ca sa hivites, ù tad jebusites, ša eṣa sware šè thy fathers abhimukham give thee, a bhū flowing ù milk ù honey, yad thou shalt keep etat service ša ne month.
seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, tathā madhye tad seventh ud shall bhū a feast šè tad lugal.
unleavened bread shall vṛt eaten seven days; api atra shall nu leavened bread me lok da thee, neither shall atra as leaven igi-du8 sahita thee antar niĝ thy quarters.
ca thou shalt shew thy putra ša iri divasa, dug4, idam is done because asya tad yaḥ bi en did abhimukham me when i ā-gam forth bahis ak egypt.

ù bi shall bhū kṛte a sign šè thee ugu thine hand, ca arthạm a memorial between thine eyes, tad eṣa lord's law may vṛt antar thy mouth: kṛte sahita a strong hand hath sa prabhu brought thee bahis asya egypt.
thou shalt therefore keep etat ordinance a tasya season ta year abhimukham year.
api bi shall gál when eṣa ensi shall bring thee šè bi bhū sya bi canaanites, as bi sware šè thee tathā abhimukham thy fathers, ca shall give tat thee,
yad thou shalt set apart šè bi lugal sarva yad openeth tad matrix, ca every firstling tad cometh sya a beast yaḥ thou hast; tad males shall bhū bi lord's.
api every firstling ak an ass thou shalt redeem ù a lamb; ca if thou wilt nu redeem idam, then thou shalt break asya neck: ù gištug bi firstborn ak lú among thy children shalt thou redeem.
u3 bi shall bhū when thy putra asketh thee antar time šè du, e, what is ne? ne thou shalt brū šè him, by strength asya hand sa prabhu brought us bahis prabhṛti egypt, tas sa é sya bondage:

api idam gin šè pass, when pharaoh would hardly gá us du, iri bi lugal slew viśva bi firstborn madhye sa kur asya egypt, both bi firstborn ak lú, ca sa firstborn ak beast: therefore i sacrifice šè eṣa ensi gištug yad openeth tad matrix, being males; but niĝ bi firstborn ak my children i redeem.
ù ne shall me kṛte a token par thine hand, ù arthạm frontlets between thine eyes: šè by strength ak hand bi nātha brought us forth è ak egypt.

u3 idam è abhimukham pass, when pharaoh had he-me bi loka yā, ne ilum led etān nu through sa way sya bi kalam ak tad philistines, although iri me near; šè deva e, lest peradventure bi ukkin repent when they lok war, api they return abhimukham egypt:
but deva led bi saĝ about, through bi way ak tad wilderness ak bi red sea: tathā bi children ak israel du up harnessed bar sya bi bhū sya egypt.
ù moses took eṣa bones asya joseph ù him: arthạm bi had straitly sworn tad children sya israel, brū, bhagavān will surely visit you; u3 ye shall carry up my bones away hence da you.
u3 they took bi-meš journey prabhṛti succoth, ù encamped ša etham, a sa edge ak sa wilderness.
u3 bi svāmin yā before bi-ne by u4 antar a pillar ak a cloud, prati lead etān tad way; ù by ge6 a a pillar asya fire, šè give etān ud; abhimukham gam by ud u3 ge6:
ayam took mā away eṣa pillar ak eṣa cloud by ud, nor eṣa pillar asya fire by rātri, ta before sa saĝ.
ù bi nātha spake šè moses, kathay,
speak prati sa children asya israel, yad they turn api encamp before pihahiroth, between migdol u3 tad sea, over against baalzephon: before bi shall ye encamp by bi sea.
mu pharaoh will vac ak bi children sya israel, they are entangled antar bi kalam, bi wilderness hath shut bi-ne madhye.
tathā i will harden pharaoh's heart, iri ani shall follow after bi-ne; ca i will me honoured par pharaoh, tathā par niĝ tasya host; iri bi egyptians may know iri i am sa prabhu. ù they did ga-nam.

ca tat as told sa nṛpa asya egypt yad eṣa ùĝ fled: u3 bi heart ak pharaoh api sya tasya servants vṛt turned against tad jana, u3 they kathay, why have we done bi, ne we have dā israel vraj ta serving us?
u3 bi gag ready tasya chariot, api took asya ukkin saha him:
tathā bi took six hundred chosen chariots, ù sarva bi chariots sya egypt, ù captains over every diš ak bi-ne.
api eṣa lugal hardened bi heart ak pharaoh ensi ak egypt, u3 sa pursued after tad children sya israel: ca bi children sya israel gen bāhya sahita an high hand.
but tad egyptians pursued after tān, sakala bi horses ù chariots sya pharaoh, u3 tasya horsemen, ù tasya army, u3 overtook etān encamping by tad sea, beside pihahiroth, before baalzephon.
u3 when pharaoh drew nigh, tad children ak israel lifted up bi-meš eyes, u3, behold, sa egyptians marched after bi-ne; u3 they gál sore afraid: u3 bi children ak israel cried è abhimukham bi lugal.
ù they brū šè moses, because ni as nu graves madhye egypt, hast thou taken us away prati kāl antar sa wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus ù us, prati carry us forth bahis sya egypt?

is nu idam bi word ne we did tell thee ša egypt, inim, he-me us alone, iri we may serve tad egyptians? arthạm ne had vṛt better mu us abhimukham serve tad egyptians, than ne we should ug7 antar eṣa wilderness.

u3 moses dug4 prati bi loka, fear ye mā, stand still, ù lok bi salvation ak bi nātha, ša sa will shew šè you šè dina: arthạm eṣa egyptians whom ye have bar abhimukham ahar, ye shall dṛś etān again na more mu ever.
tad ensi shall fight mu you, ù ye shall hold your peace.
u3 bi ensi brū prati moses, wherefore criest thou šè me? speak šè sa children ak israel, tad they vraj forward:
but lift thou up thy rod, ù stretch bāhya thine hand over eṣa sea, api vibhaj tat: api bi children ak israel shall du on śuṣka ground through eṣa antarā ak bi sea.
api i, behold, i will harden bi hearts asya bi egyptians, ù they shall follow bi-ne: api i will get me honour šu-ba pharaoh, u3 upari niĝ ani host, šu-ba tasya chariots, ca upari tasya horsemen.
ca bi egyptians shall know yad i am bi ensi, when i have gotten me honour upari pharaoh, par bi chariots, tathā ugu bi horsemen.
ù bi angel sya ilum, yaḥ gen before bi camp ak israel, removed u3 vraj behind tān; api eṣa pillar ak bi cloud yā prabhṛti before teṣām mukha, ù stood behind bi-ne:

ù ne gin between bi camp sya sa egyptians ù eṣa camp asya israel; u3 idam bhū a cloud tathā tamas šè bi-ne, but ne gave dīpti by gi6 abhimukham these: ga-nam iri tad aš prāp ul near tad other niĝ bi ge6.
ca moses stretched bar tasya hand over bi sea; ca bi svāmin caused bi sea abhimukham è back by a strong east wind viśva ne niśā, ca gag sa sea śuṣka deśa, ù tad jala as sag-ki.
ca bi children ak israel è a tad šà ak sa sea par eṣa nirjala ground: api bi ídim vṛt a wall šè bi-ne on bi-meš right hand, ca on bi-meš left.
u3 bi egyptians pursued, u3 vraj ša after bi-ne šè bi antarā ak sa sea, even viśva pharaoh's horses, ani chariots, tathā tasya horsemen.
tathā ne prāp šè pass, tad a tad uṣas watch bi en looked prati bi host sya sa egyptians through sa pillar asya fire u3 sya bi cloud, ca troubled tad host ak eṣa egyptians,
ù took off teṣām chariot wheels, ne they drave tān heavily: nu-me yad bi egyptians inim, he-me us flee ta eṣa pa sya israel; arthạm tad lugal fighteth šè etān against bi egyptians.
ù bi svāmin kathay abhimukham moses, stretch bāhya thine hand over tad sea, ne tad a may è again šu-ba eṣa egyptians, par eṣām chariots, u3 ugu bi-meš horsemen.

ù moses stretched forth tasya hand over bi sea, tathā bi sea returned šè ani strength when eṣa prātas appeared; api eṣa egyptians fled against tat; tathā tad prabhu overthrew bi egyptians a eṣa antarā ak bi sea.
ù bi a returned, tathā covered tad chariots, u3 sa horsemen, ù niĝ bi host ak pharaoh ne du šè bi sea after etān; ni remained mā ga-nam much as aš sya tān.
but bi children asya israel walked ugu bad deśa madhye bi šà ak eṣa sea; tathā sa udaka me a wall abhimukham tān on teṣām right hand, tathā on teṣām left.
thus eṣa ensi saved israel yad ahar bahis ak tad hand ak sa egyptians; api israel bar eṣa egyptians dead par sa sea shore.
ca israel igi-du8 yad mah work lú eṣa lugal did ugu tad egyptians: ù tad jana feared bi prabhu, ù believed tad ensi, ù bi servant moses.
then sang moses ù sa children ak israel ne song prati bi lugal, u3 spake, inim, i will sing prati bi en, mu ayam hath triumphed gloriously: eṣa horse ù tasya rider hath eṣa thrown a bi sea.
sa en is my strength ù song, u3 sa is become my salvation: ani is my bhagavān, u3 i will prepare him an habitation; my father's īśvara, u3 i will exalt him.
sa prabhu is a manuṣya sya war: sa prabhu is tasya name.
pharaoh's chariots ù tasya host hath bi cast antar bi sea: ani chosen captains also are drowned madhye tad red sea.
bi depths have covered bi-ne: they sank a sa bottom as a stone.
thy right hand, o ensi, is become glorious madhye power: thy right hand, o nātha, hath dashed ša pieces tad enemy.
api ša tad greatness sya thine excellency thou hast overthrown etān yad rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, yaḥ consumed etān as stubble.
u3 ù bi blast sya thy nostrils bi a vṛt saṃgṛh niĝin, bi floods stood upright as an heap, u3 bi depths me congealed antar sa heart ak bi sea.
eṣa enemy inim, i will pursue, i will overtake, i will vibhaj bi spoil; my lust shall bhū satisfied šu-ba bi-ne; i will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy etān.
thou didst blow saha thy wind, bi sea covered bi-ne: they sank as lead antar tad mighty jala.
who is like prati thee, o ensi, among sa gods? who is like thee, glorious antar holiness, fearful a praises, doing wonders?
thou stretchedst bāhya thy right hand, bi bhūmi swallowed bi-ne.
thou ša thy mercy hast led forth bi jana yaḥ thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided etān ša thy strength abhimukham thy holy habitation.
bi saĝ shall hear, api gál afraid: sorrow shall take hold on tad inhabitants sya palestina.
then eṣa dukes sya edom shall gál amazed; bi mighty men asya moab, trembling shall take hold šu-ba tān; viśva sa inhabitants ak canaan shall melt away.
fear u3 dread shall fall šu-ba tān; by bi greatness ak thine arm they shall me as still as a stone; till thy ukkin pass over, o ensi, till bi jana pass over, ša thou hast purchased.

thou shalt bring etān a, ca plant etān madhye bi mountain sya thine inheritance, antar tad šà, o svāmin, yaḥ thou hast dim mu thee abhimukham dwell antar, madhye bi sanctuary, o nātha, yaḥ thy hands have established.
bi en shall reign arthạm ever api ever.

šè bi horse sya pharaoh vraj madhye sahita tasya chariots u3 da ani horsemen antar eṣa sea, api eṣa prabhu brought again bi jala asya bi sea šu-ba bi-ne; but bi children ak israel yā on ḫad pradeśa madhye bi madhya ak bi sea.
u3 miriam sa prophetess, bi sister sya aaron, took a timbrel ša asyāḥ hand; u3 sarva sa women du bāhya after ani-munus ù timbrels u3 saha dances.
u3 miriam answered tān, sing ye prati sa prabhu, šè ani hath triumphed gloriously; sa horse tathā bi rider hath bi thrown šè tad sea.
nu-me moses brought israel ta bi red sea, ù they gam bahis a eṣa wilderness asya shur; ù they gen three days antar bi wilderness, ù found na ídim.
tathā when they du šè marah, they could nu drink ak sa ídim ak marah, šè they me bitter: therefore tad name asya tat vṛt āhva marah.
ù tad ukkin murmured against moses, e, what shall we drink?
tathā ani cried prati bi ensi; u3 bi svāmin shewed him a tree, yaḥ when eṣa had cast praviśya bi ap, tad ap as dù sweet: ni ani nirmā šè tān a statute api an ordinance, tathā ne eṣa proved bi-ne,

tathā kathay, if thou wilt diligently hearken šè sa voice ak sa prabhu thy īśvara, api wilt do ne yaḥ is right antar bi sight, ca wilt give ear šè bi commandments, u3 keep niĝ asya statutes, i will put none ak these diseases šu-ba thee, ša i have brought ugu tad egyptians: arthạm i am bi en iri healeth thee.
tathā they gin šè elim, where bhū twelve wells ak ídim, tathā threescore tathā ten palm trees: u3 they encamped tatra by sa ap.

ù they took bi-meš journey tas elim, ù sarva sa congregation ak bi children ak israel āyā šè sa wilderness ak sin, lú is between elim ca sinai, on eṣa fifteenth divasa sya sa 2-kam month after bi-meš departing bar asya bi bhū ak egypt.
u3 bi whole congregation sya bi children sya israel murmured against moses u3 aaron a bi wilderness:

tathā bi children ak israel brū prati bi-ne, would šè dingir we had died by sa hand asya bi lugal antar tad deśa sya egypt, when we sat by sa flesh pots, ù when we did eat bread šè tad full; šè ye have brought us forth praviśya idam wilderness, šè kill idam whole assembly ù hunger.
then e bi nātha prati moses, behold, i will rain bread tas naka arthạm you; ù bi saĝ shall è è ù šum a certain rate every ahar, yad i may prove bi-ne, whether they will walk ša my law, or nu.
api tat shall du šè pass, yad on bi sixth dina they shall prepare tad lú they bring a; ù ne shall bhū twice as much as they sañcay daily.
ca moses u3 aaron inim abhimukham sakala bi children ak israel, at even, then ye shall know tad tad ensi hath brought you bahis ta tad kur ak egypt:
ù antar sa u4-ul-li, then ye shall igi sa glory asya sa nātha; kṛte iri eṣa heareth your murmurings against bi nātha: api what are we, ne ye murmur against us?

tathā moses dug4, bi shall me, when bi nātha shall give you antar bi sig-ge6 flesh šè eat, tathā ša tad prātas bread abhimukham bi full; mu iri bi en heareth your murmurings ša ye murmur against him: ca what are we? your murmurings are na against us, but against tad en.
ù moses spake šè aaron, brū abhimukham šu bi congregation sya sa children sya israel, ā-gam near before bi en: kṛte ayam hath heard your murmurings.
ù bi ā-gam šè pass, as aaron spake prati bi whole congregation asya bi children asya israel, tad they looked toward eṣa wilderness, u3, behold, tad glory ak tad en appeared antar bi cloud.
ca tad svāmin spake šè moses, vac,

i have heard sa murmurings asya bi children asya israel: speak šè tān, kathay, at even ye shall eat flesh, tathā antar tad u4-ul-li ye shall bhū filled da bread; ù ye shall know yad i am bi nātha your deva.
tathā idam è prati pass, ne at even bi quails è up, tathā covered bi camp: tathā ša bi u4-zal eṣa dew lay round about sa host.
u3 when bi dew yad lay me gone up, behold, upari sa vadana asya eṣa wilderness ni lay a small round thing, as small as bi hoar frost on bi ground.
ù when eṣa children ak israel igi idam, they vac diš abhimukham another, bi is manna: šè they wist mā what tat as. u3 moses brū prati bi-ne, etat is tad bread ša eṣa nātha hath given you šè eat.

etat is tad thing yad eṣa en hath commanded, saṃgṛh asya bi every guruš according šè bi eating, an omer arthạm every guruš, according šè tad number ak your persons; take ye every manuṣya arthạm tān ša are madhye tasya tents.
api tad children ak israel did nu-me, u3 gar, some more, some less.
tathā when they did mete idam ù an omer, ani tad šum much had nothing over, ù bi yad saṃgṛh little had nu lack; they šum every puruṣa according abhimukham tasya eating.
u3 moses dug4, anujñā nu manuṣya leave ak tat till tad uṣas.
notwithstanding they hearkened nu prati moses; but some ak tān left asya bi until bi prātas, ù idam bred worms, u3 stank: tathā moses as wroth ù bi-ne.
ù they sañcay idam every u4-ul-li, every nara according prati bi eating: ù when tad sun waxed hot, tat melted.
ù tat ā-gam šè pass, yad on sa sixth divasa they šum twice as much bread, dvau omers mu eka nitadam: u3 šu bi rulers sya sa congregation ā-gam tathā told moses.

ù bi kathay šè tān, bi is yad ša bi prabhu hath e, prati morrow is tad rest ak eṣa holy sabbath prati eṣa en: bake ne yaḥ ye will bake prati ud, ca seethe ne ye will seethe; u3 ne lú remaineth over lay up kṛte you šè me kept until sa u4-zal.
u3 they laid ne up till bi prātas, as moses bade: u3 tat did na stink, neither as atra any worm therein.
ca moses e, eat yad abhimukham u4; mu šè u4 is a sabbath abhimukham bi en: abhimukham ahar ye shall na find ne a tad field.
six days ye shall saṃgṛh idam; but on bi seventh dina, yad is bi sabbath, a tat atra shall gál none.
u3 ne è šè pass, tad ne gen bar some ak sa loka on tad seventh dina mu prati sañcay, tathā they found none.
tathā bi nātha e abhimukham moses, how long refuse ye prati keep my commandments ù my laws?

paś, arthạm yad bi prabhu hath given you bi sabbath, therefore sa giveth you on bi sixth ud bi bread ak min days; abide ye every nitadam madhye ani sthāna, dā na lú yā bar asya bi ki on sa seventh divasa.
nu-me bi loka rested on bi seventh ud.
tathā sa geh sya israel nam tad name thereof manna: ca ne vṛt like coriander seed, white; ù eṣa taste sya ne vṛt like wafers kṛ saha honey.

api moses e, bi is bi thing yaḥ eṣa en commandeth, fill an omer sya bi prati me kept mu your generations; iri they may igi eṣa bread wherewith i have fed you madhye bi wilderness, when i brought you forth ta sa bhū sya egypt.
ca moses dug4 šè aaron, take a pot, api put an omer full ak manna therein, ù lay tat up before eṣa en, šè bhū kept mu your generations.
as bi en commanded moses, nu-me aaron laid tat up before eṣa testimony, šè as kept.
api sa children ak israel did eat manna forty years, until they ā-gam abhimukham a bhū inhabited; they did eat manna, until they gin prati eṣa borders ak tad kalam sya canaan.
now an omer is bi tenth part ak an ephah.

tathā sarva bi congregation sya bi children asya israel journeyed tas tad wilderness sya sin, after bi-meš journeys, according prati bi commandment sya tad prabhu, ca pitched ša rephidim: api atra bhū na ídim šè eṣa ùĝ abhimukham drink.
wherefore bi saĝ did chide saha moses, ca brū, give us ap ne we may drink. ù moses vac prati bi-ne, why chide ye da me? wherefore do ye tempt sa en?
u3 eṣa saĝ thirsted tatra mu jala; tathā bi ùĝ murmured against moses, tathā vac, wherefore is bi ne thou hast brought us up bahis asya egypt, šè kill us api our children ca our cattle da thirst?
ù moses cried šè bi en, inim, what shall i do šè bi ùĝ? they me almost ready prati stone me.
ù bi nātha inim šè moses, gam on before bi loka, ù take sahita thee ak bi elders sya israel; u3 thy rod, wherewith thou smotest eṣa river, take madhye thine hand, u3 è.

behold, i will stand before thee ni šu-ba bi rock madhye horeb; api thou shalt smite sa rock, ù ni shall du udaka è ak tat, ne tad prajā may drink. ca moses did ga-nam a sa sight ak bi elders sya israel.
tathā sa mu-ù bi name ak bi šà massah, u3 meribah, because ak sa chiding asya bi children ak israel, api because they tempted bi nātha, brū, is bi lugal among us, or nu?
then è amalek, tathā fought sahita israel antar rephidim.
api moses e šè joshua, choose us bāhya men, ù è è, fight saha amalek: šè morrow i will stand on tad top sya bi hill sahita bi rod asya an madhye mine hand.
evam joshua did as moses had kathay šè him, api fought ù amalek: api moses, aaron, ù hur gen up prati sa top ak bi hill.
ù ne du šè pass, when moses held up ani hand, yad israel prevailed: tathā when sa dā down tasya hand, amalek prevailed.

but moses' hands bhū heavy; api they took a stone, api put bi nīce him, ù ani sat thereon; ù aaron ù hur stayed up tasya hands, bi eka on sa aš side, u3 tad other on bi other side; ca ani hands as steady until sa going down sya sa sun.
u3 joshua discomfited amalek ù bi ùĝ da bi edge ak eṣa sword.
ù bi ensi dug4 šè moses, write idam šè a memorial a a book, ca rehearse tat ša bi ears ak joshua: kṛte i will utterly put è bi remembrance sya amalek prabhṛti kur anki.
api moses built an altar, ù hve sa name sya idam jehovahnissi:
šè ayam kathay, because bi nātha hath sworn iri bi prabhu will have war da amalek ta generation šè generation.
when jethro, bi priest ak midian, moses' father antar law, heard sya šu yad dingir had done kṛte moses, tathā arthạm israel bi prajā, tathā iri bi en had brought israel bar sya egypt;
then jethro, moses' father ša law, took zipporah, moses' wife, after sa had sent ani-munus back,
u3 ani-munus dvi putra; ak yaḥ tad name asya tad eka vṛt gershom; arthạm ayam vac, i have gál an alien ša a strange bhū:
u3 tad name sya bi other gál eliezer; arthạm bi an asya my father, inim ayam, as mine help, ca delivered me ta eṣa sword ak pharaoh:
ù jethro, moses' father a law, gin saha asya dumu u3 asya wife šè moses antar bi wilderness, where sa encamped at tad mount ak deva:
ù ayam dug4 prati moses, i thy father a law jethro am prāp šè thee, ù thy wife, u3 tasyāḥ dvau ibila saha ani-munus.
api moses gam è abhimukham meet ani father ša law, api did obeisance, u3 kissed him; api they asked each other ak teṣām welfare; ca they gin praviśya sa tent.
u3 moses told bi father madhye law sarva tad bi lugal had done prati pharaoh u3 šè bi egyptians mu israel's sake, u3 gištug bi travail ne had du šu-ba tān by bi way, tathā how sa en delivered bi-ne.
u3 jethro rejoiced mu šu eṣa goodness yad sa en had done šè israel, whom ani had delivered è ak bi hand sya bi egyptians.
api jethro e, blessed vṛt sa ensi, who hath delivered you bar ak sa hand asya bi egyptians, ù bāhya ak bi hand ak pharaoh, who hath delivered bi prajā ta kur eṣa hand sya bi egyptians.
now i know iri tad lugal is greater than gištug gods: mu ša bi thing wherein they dealt proudly ani bhū ūrdhva tān.
ù jethro, moses' father ša law, took a burnt offering ù sacrifices arthạm an: ca aaron prāp, ù viśva bi elders ak israel, šè eat bread sahita moses' father madhye law before dingir.
ù tat gin prati pass on bi morrow, ne moses sat prati judge bi jana: api tad prajā stood by moses tas eṣa u4-zal prati tad sandhyā.

ù when moses' father antar law igi niĝ tad eṣa did šè bi ukkin, eṣa brū, what is ne thing iri thou doest šè tad ùĝ? why sittest thou thyself alone, u3 niĝ bi jana stand by thee tas u4-zal abhimukham even?
ca moses kathay abhimukham asya father ša law, because bi loka è prati me prati enquire ak ilum:
when they have a matter, they du prati me; u3 i judge between aš ù another, api i do vidh bi-ne know bi statutes asya bhagavān, tathā ani laws.
ca moses' father ša law dug4 šè him, sa thing iri thou doest is ul du10.
thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, ca idam ùĝ iri is da thee: kṛte idam thing is too heavy mu thee; thou art na able prati perform idam thyself alone.
hearken now abhimukham my voice, i will give thee counsel, tathā dingir shall gál ù thee: as thou arthạm bi loka abhimukham god-ward, iri thou mayest bring eṣa causes šè īśvara:
u3 thou shalt teach bi-ne ordinances tathā laws, tathā shalt shew bi-ne tad way wherein they must walk, ca bi work iri they must do.

moreover thou shalt provide è ak sakala eṣa ukkin able men, such as fear ilum, men ak truth, hating covetousness; ù ki such over bi-ne, šè me rulers asya thousands, api rulers ak hundreds, rulers ak fifties, tathā rulers ak tens:

u3 dā tān judge tad ùĝ at gištug seasons: ca bi shall gál, yad every bṛhat matter they shall bring šè thee, but every small matter they shall judge: ga-nam shall idam vṛt easier šè thyself, ù they shall bear bi burden sahita thee.
if thou shalt do ne thing, api an command thee ittham, then thou shalt me able abhimukham endure, ù šu etat ùĝ shall also gam šè bi-meš deśa a peace.
nu-me moses hearkened prati eṣa voice sya tasya father a law, api did niĝ tad bi had vac.
u3 moses chose able men bahis sya šu israel, ù dù bi-ne heads over eṣa ùĝ, rulers ak thousands, rulers ak hundreds, rulers ak fifties, ù rulers asya tens.
ca they judged tad saĝ at sakala seasons: tad hard causes they brought prati moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
tathā moses dā tasya father madhye law depart; ca ani vraj tasya way antar bi own kalam.
a bi 3-kam month, when bi children asya israel me gone forth bar ak bi kur ak egypt, eṣa same u4 è they a eṣa wilderness ak sinai.
kṛte they bhū departed tas rephidim, ca me āyā prati bi desert asya sinai, ca had pitched a eṣa wilderness; ù atra israel camped before bi mount.
ca moses è up šè an, ù bi ensi gu3-dé prati him bar ak bi mountain, e, thus shalt thou inim šè bi gṛha asya jacob, ca tell sa children ak israel;
ye have igi-du8 what i did šè eṣa egyptians, u3 how i bare you on eagles' wings, u3 brought you šè myself.
now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, ù keep my covenant, then ye shall me a peculiar treasure prati me upari sakala prajā: šè niĝ tad uraš is mine:
api ye shall gál šè me a kingdom ak priests, ca an holy nation. these are sa words lú thou shalt speak šè bi children sya israel.
api moses prāp ù nam kṛte tad elders ak bi prajā, tathā laid before bi-meš faces sarva these words lú bi nātha commanded him.
u3 gištug bi ùĝ answered ús, ù dug4, šu ne tad prabhu hath spoken we will do. ca moses returned bi words asya bi saĝ šè eṣa prabhu.
api eṣa ensi brū prati moses, lo, i è šè thee madhye a thick cloud, ne eṣa loka may hear when i speak ù thee, ca believe thee mu ever. ca moses told eṣa words ak tad loka šè bi ensi.
ù bi en vac prati moses, du šè bi ukkin, tathā sanctify tān šè u4 ù šè morrow, tathā dā tān wash bi-meš clothes,
ca as ready against bi eš u4: arthạm bi tṛtīya dina tad svāmin will prāp down a bi sight ak šu bi ukkin šu-ba mount sinai.

api thou shalt set bounds šè bi loka round about, kathay, take heed abhimukham yourselves, ne ye gam mā up a tad mount, or touch sa border sya bi: whosoever toucheth eṣa mount shall vṛt surely put šè úš:

tatra shall ul an hand touch idam, but ayam shall surely bhū stoned, or shot through; whether bi gál beast or puruṣa, idam shall nu vṛt: when eṣa trumpet soundeth long, they shall ā-gam up šè eṣa mount.
tathā moses gam down ta eṣa mount šè bi jana, ca sanctified bi ukkin; u3 they washed teṣām clothes.
api ani inim šè bi jana, gál ready against sa tri divasa: prāp ul at your wives.

api idam è šè pass on sa tri divasa a bi u4-ul-li, tad ni vṛt thunders ca lightnings, ù a thick cloud par sa mount, u3 eṣa voice asya bi trumpet exceeding loud; evam yad niĝ bi prajā tad me a bi camp trembled.
u3 moses brought forth bi loka è ak eṣa camp prati meet da bhagavān; u3 they stood at bi nether part sya bi mount.
u3 mount sinai me altogether on a smoke, because bi en descended šu-ba tat antar fire: ca tad smoke thereof ascended as bi smoke asya a furnace, u3 eṣa whole mount quaked greatly.
ca when sa voice ak bi trumpet sounded long, api waxed louder ù louder, moses spake, tathā bhagavān answered him by a voice.
u3 eṣa en āyā down ugu mount sinai, on sa top sya tad mount: u3 bi nātha gu3-dé moses up abhimukham bi top ak tad mount; ca moses gam up.
api bi en kathay prati moses, yā down, charge bi prajā, lest they break through prati tad nātha šè gaze, ca many ak tān perish.
ù dā sa priests also, lú prāp near abhimukham eṣa en, sanctify themselves, lest eṣa ensi break forth upari tān.
u3 moses e šè bi ensi, eṣa ùĝ cannot è up prati mount sinai: kṛte thou chargedst us, brū, set bounds about bi mount, ù sanctify bi.

api bi svāmin inim šè him, away, get thee down, ù thou shalt ā-gam up, thou, ù aaron saha thee: but anujñā nu bi priests ù tad loka break through šè ā-gam up abhimukham eṣa nātha, lest ayam break forth šu-ba bi-ne.
evam moses vraj down šè tad ukkin, api spake abhimukham bi-ne.
tathā īśvara spake sakala these words, brū,
i am eṣa prabhu thy bhagavān, lú have brought thee bar ak bi kur ak egypt, è ak bi sadana ak bondage.
thou shalt have nahi other gods before me.
thou shalt na dù šè thee any graven image, or any likeness asya any thing ne is madhye an ūrdhva, or yad is madhye bi bhūmi beneath, or ne is a eṣa jala nīce bi ki:

thou shalt nu bow down thyself šè tān, nor serve etān: mu i bi svāmin thy an am a jealous dingir, visiting bi iniquity ak bi fathers ugu bi children abhimukham bi eš api fourth generation ak bi-ne ne hate me;
tathā shewing mercy abhimukham thousands ak bi-ne tad love me, u3 keep my commandments.
thou shalt mā take bi name ak bi ensi thy deva ša vain; kṛte tad prabhu will mā hold him guiltless yad taketh bi name a vain.
remember sa sabbath ud, šè keep ne holy.
six days shalt thou labour, u3 do gištug thy work:

but tad seventh dina is bi sabbath asya sa lugal thy dingir: a tat thou shalt nu do any work, thou, nor thy putra, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger yad is within thy gates:
arthạm a six days bi nātha vidh anki api uraš, bi sea, ca šu iri antar bi-ne is, ca rested sa seventh dina: wherefore bi ensi blessed bi sabbath ud, ù hallowed ne.
honour thy father ù thy mother: tad thy days may gál long par bi kalam yad tad en thy īśvara giveth thee.
thou shalt na kill.
thou shalt mā commit adultery.
thou shalt ul steal.
thou shalt ul bear false witness against thy neighbour.
thou shalt ul covet thy neighbour's ki-gal, thou shalt nu covet thy neighbour's wife, nor tasya manservant, nor tasya maidservant, nor tasya ox, nor bi ass, nor any thing ne is thy neighbour's.
u3 sarva eṣa saĝ igi sa thunderings, ca tad lightnings, api bi noise sya bi trumpet, ca tad mountain smoking: u3 when bi prajā dṛś ne, they removed, tathā stood afar off.
ca they kathay šè moses, speak thou da us, u3 we will hear: but gá ul īśvara speak ù us, lest we pralī.
u3 moses vac abhimukham bi saĝ, fear ul: mu bhagavān is gin šè prove you, ù ne tasya fear may as before your faces, yad ye sin mā.
ù eṣa jana stood afar off, ca moses drew near šè bi thick kuku where ilum bhū.
tathā bi prabhu inim šè moses, thus thou shalt inim abhimukham bi children sya israel, ye have lok ne i have talked ù you tas anu.
ye shall nu kṛ ù me gods asya silver, neither shall ye nirmā šè you gods ak gold.

an altar sya bhūmi thou shalt gag prati me, ù shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, tathā thy peace offerings, thy sheep, ù thine oxen: ša sarva places where i record my name i will gin šè thee, ù i will bless thee.
ca if thou wilt vidh me an altar sya stone, thou shalt mā build ne ak hewn stone: kṛte if thou lift up thy tool par ne, thou hast polluted tat.
neither shalt thou gen up by steps šè mine altar, tad thy nakedness me mā discovered thereon.
now these are bi judgments yaḥ thou shalt set before etān.
if thou buy an hebrew servant, six years ayam shall serve: ca ša tad seventh bi shall du bāhya free šè nothing.
if sa prāp a by himself, ani shall gam è by himself: if bi vṛt married, then tasya wife shall vraj bahis da him.
if tasya master have given him a wife, u3 she have born him ātmaja or daughters; bi wife api ani-munus children shall gál tasyāḥ master's, tathā bi shall du bar by himself.
api if bi servant shall plainly kathay, i love my master, my wife, api my children; i will na vraj bāhya free:

then bi master shall bring him abhimukham sa judges; ani shall also bring him šè bi door, or prati bi door post; tathā ani master shall bore tasya ear through saha an aul; api bi shall serve him mu ever.
u3 if a lú sell bi daughter šè gál a maidservant, she shall ul gam bar as bi menservants do.

if she please ul asyāḥ master, who hath betrothed ani-munus šè himself, then shall bi he-me tasyāḥ gál redeemed: prati sell asyāḥ abhimukham a strange nation eṣa shall have nahi power, seeing ani hath dealt deceitfully saha ani-munus.
tathā if ani have betrothed ani-munus prati tasya ibila, sa shall deal ù tasyāḥ after bi manner asya daughters.
