if eṣa take him another wife; ani-munus food, asyāḥ raiment, tathā tasyāḥ duty ak marriage, shall eṣa mā diminish.
api if ayam do nu these three abhimukham ani-munus, then shall she gen è free vinā money.
sa ne smiteth a manuṣya, nu-me ne bi úš, shall bhū surely put šè maraṇa.
ù if a lú lie nu a wait, but ilum deliver him šè tasya hand; then i will appoint thee a šà whither bi shall flee.
but if a nitadam ā-gam presumptuously par bi neighbour, abhimukham slay him saha guile; thou shalt take him tas mine altar, tad ayam may ug7.
u3 eṣa iri smiteth ani father, or bi mother, shall vṛt surely put šè úš.
tathā ayam tad stealeth a lú, u3 selleth him, or if sa gál found madhye ani hand, ani shall surely me put abhimukham ug7.
ù ani ne curseth tasya father, or bi mother, shall surely gál put šè maraṇa.
tathā if men strive saṃyuktam, api eka smite another sahita a stone, or saha bi fist, u3 sa úš ul, but keepeth tasya bed:
if eṣa rise again, u3 walk abroad ugu ani staff, then shall ayam iri smote him as quit: only ani shall pay šè tad loss asya tasya time, ca shall cause him šè bhū thoroughly healed.
ù if a nara smite asya servant, or ani maid, sahita a rod, ù sa ug7 adhas tasya hand; bi shall gál surely punished.
notwithstanding, if sa continue a dina or dvau, eṣa shall mā as punished: arthạm ani is bi money.

if men strive, tathā hurt a nārī saha child, ittham tad ani-munus fruit depart ta tasyāḥ, ù yet nahi mischief follow: bi shall gál surely punished, according as sa woman's husband will lay šu-ba him; tathā eṣa shall pay as bi judges determine.
ù if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give nam-ti kṛte nam-ti,
eye arthạm eye, tooth mu tooth, hand šè hand, foot kṛte foot,
burning kṛte burning, wound kṛte wound, stripe kṛte stripe.
tathā if a manuṣya smite bi eye asya asya servant, or bi eye asya ani maid, ne tat perish; ani shall dā him du free arthạm bi eye's sake.
u3 if ani smite bar ani manservant's tooth, or ani maidservant's tooth; eṣa shall anujñā him vraj free kṛte bi tooth's sake.
if an ox gore a manuṣya or a dam, yad they ug7: then sa ox shall me surely stoned, ca asya flesh shall na gál eaten; but tad owner ak bi ox shall gál quit.

but if bi ox bhū wont abhimukham push ù ani horn ša time past, ca tat hath me testified šè tasya owner, tathā sa hath mā kept him a, but iri ani hath killed a nitadam or a yoṣit; bi ox shall me stoned, u3 ani owner also shall gál put prati maraṇa.
if atra me laid on him a sum sya money, then ayam shall give arthạm eṣa ransom ak asya āyus whatsoever is laid par him.
whether eṣa have gored a suta, or have gored a daughter, according šè ne judgment shall ne gál done abhimukham him.
if sa ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; ani shall give šè eṣām master thirty shekels asya silver, ca tad ox shall as stoned.
api if a lú shall open a pit, or if a nitadam shall dig a pit, ù ul cover bi, u3 an ox or an ass fall therein;
tad owner asya eṣa pit shall dim tat silim, u3 give money šè bi owner ak bi-ne; tathā sa dead beast shall bhū bi.
ù if prathama man's ox hurt another's, tad ani ug7; then they shall sell bi vṛt ox, u3 sag-ki bi money asya idam; ù sa dead ox also they shall vibhaj.
or if bi bhū known ne bi ox hath used abhimukham push antar time past, tathā asya owner hath nu kept him antar; bi shall surely pay ox šè ox; ù eṣa dead shall vṛt tasya own.
if a guruš shall steal an ox, or a sheep, ca kill bi, or sell bi; sa shall restore five oxen šè an ox, tathā four sheep kṛte a sheep.
if a thief me found breaking up, api bhū smitten ne sa ug7, tatra shall nu blood me shed arthạm him.
if bi sun vṛt risen ugu him, tatra shall me blood shed šè him; kṛte sa should dim full restitution; if ayam have nothing, then sa shall bhū sold kṛte asya theft.
if bi theft gál certainly found madhye bi hand alive, whether bi me ox, or ass, or sheep; bi shall restore double.

if a lú shall cause a field or vineyard šè gál eaten, ca shall put a tasya beast, tathā shall feed ša another man's field; ak bi best sya asya own field, u3 sya eṣa best asya bi own vineyard, shall ani dim restitution.
if fire break è, ù catch madhye thorns, ittham yad bi stacks asya corn, or sa standing corn, or tad field, as consumed therewith; bi yad kindled bi fire shall surely kṛ restitution.
if a lú shall deliver prati bi neighbour money or stuff prati keep, ù ne as stolen bahis asya tad man's é; if tad thief as found, gá him pay double.
if bi thief me mā found, then eṣa master asya bi ki-gal shall as brought prati tad judges, prati lok whether ani have put asya hand šè tasya neighbour's goods.

kṛte sarva manner ak trespass, whether bi me šè ox, šè ass, kṛte sheep, arthạm raiment, or kṛte any manner ak lost thing, yad another challengeth šè me ani, bi cause ak both parties shall āyā before tad judges; api whom bi judges shall condemn, ani shall pay double šè tasya neighbour.
if a lú deliver šè bi neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, šè keep; ca idam úš, or bhū hurt, or driven away, nu manuṣya seeing tat:
then shall an oath ak bi svāmin as between tān both, tad sa hath nu put bi hand abhimukham bi neighbour's goods; u3 tad owner asya bi shall accept thereof, api ani shall na nirmā bi sundara.
tathā if tat gál stolen tas him, bi shall kṛ restitution prati bi owner thereof.
if ne bhū torn antar pieces, then dā him bring tat šè witness, u3 bi shall nu kṛ śubha iri ša vṛt torn.
api if a guruš borrow ought ak ani neighbour, ù tat vṛt hurt, or pralī, bi owner thereof being nu ù bi, ayam shall surely nirmā idam du10.
but if bi owner thereof bhū ù tat, sa shall na nirmā idam sundara: if idam bhū an hired thing, ne è šè tasya hire.
u3 if a lú entice a maid iri is nu betrothed, u3 lie saha ani-munus, ani shall surely endow asyāḥ prati gál tasya wife.
if ani-munus father utterly refuse šè give tasyāḥ abhimukham him, eṣa shall pay money according prati bi dowry asya virgins.
thou shalt mā suffer a witch šè ti.
whosoever lieth saha a beast shall surely gál put šè ug7.
sa ne sacrificeth šè any bhagavān, save šè tad ensi only, ani shall me utterly destroyed.
thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: mu ye bhū strangers ša bi kalam asya egypt.
ye shall ul afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
if thou afflict bi-ne a any wise, ù they cry at niĝ prati me, i will surely hear bi-meš cry;
ca my wrath shall wax hot, ù i will kill you da bi sword; ù your wives shall me widows, u3 your children fatherless.
if thou lend money šè any ak my prajā yad is poor by thee, thou shalt na bhū šè him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay ugu him usury.
if thou at niĝ take thy neighbour's raiment šè pledge, thou shalt deliver tat prati him by yad tad sun goeth down:
arthạm tad is asya covering only, bi is ani raiment arthạm asya skin: wherein shall bi sleep? ù bi shall du abhimukham pass, when ayam crieth prati me, tad i will hear; kṛte i am gracious.
thou shalt mā revile bi gods, nor curse eṣa ruler sya thy jana.
thou shalt na delay šè offer eṣa 1-kam sya thy ripe fruits, ca asya thy liquors: eṣa firstborn asya thy dumu shalt thou give šè me.
likewise shalt thou do sahita thine oxen, ca saha thy sheep: seven days idam shall gál sahita bi dam; on sa eighth ud thou shalt give tat me.
tathā ye shall bhū holy men prati me: neither shall ye eat any flesh yad is torn ak beasts madhye bi field; ye shall cast tat abhimukham sa dogs.
thou shalt nu raise a false report: put na thine hand sahita bi wicked šè gál an unrighteous witness.
thou shalt na follow a multitude prati do evil; neither shalt thou speak ša a cause šè decline after many abhimukham wrest judgment:
neither shalt thou countenance a poor guruš madhye bi cause.
if thou meet thine enemy's ox or ani ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring ne back abhimukham him again.
if thou bar bi ass asya him ne hateth thee lying adhas bi burden, u3 wouldest forbear abhimukham help him, thou shalt surely help ù him.
thou shalt na wrest bi judgment ak thy poor madhye asya cause.
keep thee far tas a false matter; u3 tad innocent u3 righteous slay thou mā: mu i will mā justify sa wicked.
ca thou shalt take nu gift: šè eṣa gift blindeth eṣa wise, ù perverteth tad words ak sa righteous.
also thou shalt na oppress a stranger: kṛte ye know sa heart asya a stranger, seeing ye me strangers antar sa deśa sya egypt.
ù six years thou shalt sow thy deśa, ù shalt šum a bi fruits thereof:

but eṣa seventh year thou shalt he-me ne rest api lie still; ne bi poor sya thy ùĝ may eat: ù what they leave bi beasts sya bi field shall eat. ša like manner thou shalt deal saha thy vineyard, tathā ù thy oliveyard.
six days thou shalt do thy work, ca on bi seventh divasa thou shalt rest: yad thine ox u3 thine ass may rest, u3 eṣa ātmaja sya thy handmaid, ca eṣa stranger, may vṛt refreshed.
api antar šu things tad i have dug4 abhimukham you me circumspect: api gag nu mention asya bi name ak other gods, neither he-me tat as heard bar sya thy mouth.
three times thou shalt keep a feast šè me madhye tad year.

thou shalt keep tad feast ak unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as i commanded thee, madhye bi time appointed ak sa month abib; arthạm antar bi thou camest è ta egypt: ca none shall dṛś before me empty :)

api tad feast sya harvest, bi firstfruits sya thy labours, yaḥ thou hast sown ša sa field: tathā sa feast ak ingathering, yaḥ is ša eṣa end ak tad year, when thou hast sañcay madhye thy labours è ak bi field.
three times madhye bi year šu thy males shall prakāś before tad svāmin bhagavān.
thou shalt na offer bi blood sya my sacrifice saha leavened bread; neither shall sa fat sya my sacrifice remain until bi prātas.
bi imin ak bi firstfruits asya thy kalam thou shalt bring antar tad geh asya eṣa nātha thy dingir. thou shalt na seethe a kid a tasya mother's milk.
behold, i send an angel before thee, prati keep thee a eṣa way, u3 šè bring thee a eṣa šà lú i have prepared.
beware sya him, ca obey ani voice, provoke him na; šè ani will na pardon your transgressions: arthạm my name is madhye him.
but if thou shalt indeed obey bi voice, ù do viśva ne i speak; then i will bhū an enemy abhimukham thine enemies, u3 an adversary šè thine adversaries.
arthạm mine angel shall gam before thee, ù bring thee antar šè bi amorites, tathā sa hittites, api sa perizzites, tathā bi canaanites, sa hivites, ca bi jebusites: tathā i will cut bi-ne off.
thou shalt nu bow down šè teṣām gods, nor serve bi-ne, nor do after teṣām works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow bi-ne, ca quite break down bi-meš images.
ca ye shall serve tad ensi your an, u3 ani shall bless thy bread, u3 thy ídim; ù i will take sickness away ta sa šà ak thee.
atra shall nothing cast bi-meš young, nor vṛt barren, a thy kur: bi number sya thy days i will fulfil.
i will send my fear before thee, ca will destroy sarva eṣa jana prati whom thou shalt prāp, tathā i will nirmā niĝ thine enemies turn bi-meš backs šè thee.
tathā i will send hornets before thee, ša shall drive bāhya tad hivite, eṣa canaanite, tathā bi hittite, tas before thee.
i will mā drive etān bar ta before thee a aš year; lest bi kalam become desolate, ù bi beast sya tad field multiply against thee.
by little ca little i will drive bi-ne bāhya tas before thee, until thou gál increased, ca inherit sa bhū.

u3 i will set thy bounds ta bi red sea even prati bi sea asya bi philistines, u3 ta tad desert abhimukham sa river: mu i will deliver bi inhabitants asya sa bhū šè your hand; u3 thou shalt drive tān bahis before thee.
thou shalt dim nu covenant ù bi-ne, nor sahita teṣām gods.
they shall mā dwell antar thy kur, lest they kṛ thee sin against me: mu if thou serve teṣām gods, idam will surely bhū a snare abhimukham thee.
u3 ani inim šè moses, āyā up prati eṣa lugal, thou, ù aaron, nadab, ù abihu, tathā seventy ak bi elders asya israel; ù worship ye afar off.
ca moses alone shall ā-gam near bi nātha: but they shall mā āyā nigh; neither shall sa prajā du up sahita him.
u3 moses ā-gam u3 told bi ùĝ sarva sa words ak bi nātha, tathā sakala eṣa judgments: u3 šu bi jana answered da diš voice, ù vac, sakala sa words yaḥ bi prabhu hath brū will we do.
api moses wrote niĝ eṣa words ak tad en, ca rose up early ša sa uṣas, ù builded an altar nīce eṣa hill, tathā twelve pillars, according šè bi twelve tribes ak israel.
u3 ani sent young men sya eṣa children sya israel, ša offered burnt offerings, u3 sacrificed peace offerings ak oxen šè eṣa svāmin.
ca moses took half asya bi blood, api put idam madhye basons; ù half ak tad blood ayam sprinkled on sa altar.
u3 eṣa took bi book asya bi covenant, u3 read ša eṣa audience ak bi ùĝ: ù they kathay, sarva iri bi en hath kathay will we do, ù vṛt obedient.
ù moses took bi blood, ca sprinkled bi on bi ùĝ, ca inim, behold tad blood asya bi covenant, yaḥ bi prabhu hath gag saha you concerning gištug these words.
then yā up moses, ù aaron, nadab, u3 abihu, ca seventy ak bi elders sya israel:
ca they paś bi īśvara asya israel: api tatra gál nīce bi feet as ne bhū a paved work ak a sapphire stone, ù as ne me sa body sya svarga a tasya clearness.
ù ugu bi nobles sya tad children ak israel eṣa laid mā ani hand: also they lok īśvara, tathā did eat ca drink.

ù bi prabhu kathay abhimukham moses, du up abhimukham me praviśya bi mount, tathā bhū tatra: u3 i will give thee tables ak stone, ù a law, ca commandments yaḥ i have written; ne thou mayest teach etān.
api moses rose up, u3 asya minister joshua: ù moses du up a tad mount asya an.
ù ani e prati tad elders, tarry ye here mu us, until we prāp again prati you: ù, behold, aaron tathā hur are saha you: if any manuṣya have any matters šè do, gá him prāp prati bi-ne.
u3 moses du up praviśya tad mount, api a cloud covered bi mount.
ù bi glory ak bi prabhu abode upari mount sinai, ù tad cloud covered ne six days: tathā tad seventh divasa ani nam abhimukham moses è asya bi šà sya bi cloud.
u3 bi sight sya tad glory sya bi ensi gál like devouring fire on bi top ak bi mount antar tad eyes sya eṣa children ak israel.
u3 moses gen a bi šà asya eṣa cloud, u3 gat him up a bi mount: ù moses me ša bi mount forty days tathā forty nights.
tathā bi svāmin spake prati moses, inim,
speak šè eṣa children sya israel, yad they bring me an offering: ak every nara tad giveth idam willingly saha asya heart ye shall take my offering.
ca bi is sa offering yad ye shall take asya etān; gold, tathā silver, api brass,
tathā blue, ù purple, ù scarlet, ù fine linen, api goats' hair,
ù rams' skins dyed red, ca badgers' skins, ca shittim wood,
oil kṛte bi dīpti, spices kṛte anointing oil, u3 mu sweet incense,
onyx stones, u3 stones šè bhū set a eṣa ephod, u3 a sa breastplate.
u3 gá tān nirmā me a sanctuary; yad i may dwell among bi-ne.
according abhimukham sakala yad i shew thee, after bi pattern ak eṣa tabernacle, ù tad pattern asya viśva bi instruments thereof, even evam shall ye kṛ tat.
ù they shall kṛ an ark sya shittim wood: dvau cubits api a half shall bhū bi length thereof, ù a cubit u3 a half bi breadth thereof, u3 a cubit ca a half sa height thereof.
u3 thou shalt overlay tat saha pure gold, within ù nu shalt thou overlay tat, ù shalt gag šu-ba ne a crown asya gold round about.
ù thou shalt cast four rings ak gold arthạm idam, ù put bi-ne a eṣa four corners thereof; ù dvi rings shall as ša bi prathama side asya ne, api dvau rings ša bi other side ak tat.
tathā thou shalt dim staves ak shittim wood, u3 overlay tān ù gold.
ca thou shalt put sa staves antar sa rings by tad sides ak tad ark, tad sa ark may bhū borne da bi-ne.
tad staves shall as antar bi rings asya bi ark: they shall mā me taken ta tat.
ca thou shalt put šè tad ark bi testimony yad i shall give thee.
ca thou shalt dim a mercy seat ak pure gold: dvi cubits ù a half shall me bi length thereof, ù a cubit u3 a half sa breadth thereof.
ca thou shalt nirmā dvau cherubims ak gold, ak beaten work shalt thou gag bi-ne, ša sa dvi ends ak bi mercy seat.
tathā kṛ aš cherub on sa diš end, u3 bi other cherub on bi other end: even asya eṣa mercy seat shall ye dù tad cherubims on bi min ends thereof.
u3 bi cherubims shall stretch forth eṣām wings on high, covering bi mercy seat da bi-meš wings, ù bi-meš faces shall look aš prati another; toward eṣa mercy seat shall bi faces ak bi cherubims me.
ca thou shalt put eṣa mercy seat ūrdhva šu-ba sa ark; ù madhye sa ark thou shalt put bi testimony iri i shall give thee.

u3 tatra i will meet da thee, api i will commune da thee ta an-ta bi mercy seat, tas between bi min cherubims ša are ugu sa ark ak sa testimony, ak niĝ things yaḥ i will give thee antar commandment šè bi children ak israel.
thou shalt also kṛ a table asya shittim wood: dvau cubits shall bhū bi length thereof, api a cubit tad breadth thereof, tathā a cubit ca a half eṣa height thereof.
ù thou shalt overlay ne da pure gold, ca nirmā thereto a crown ak gold round about.
tathā thou shalt dù prati tat a border ak an hand breadth round about, ù thou shalt vidh a golden crown prati bi border thereof round about.
api thou shalt dim mu tat four rings ak gold, ù put bi rings antar bi four corners iri are on eṣa four feet thereof.
over against eṣa border shall bi rings gál mu places ak bi staves abhimukham bear tad table.
api thou shalt dim eṣa staves sya shittim wood, tathā overlay bi-ne ù gold, iri bi table may me borne sahita bi-ne.
tathā thou shalt nirmā tad dishes thereof, tathā spoons thereof, u3 covers thereof, u3 bowls thereof, prati cover withal: sya pure gold shalt thou kṛ etān.
api thou shalt set par bi table shewbread before me alway.
tathā thou shalt gag a candlestick asya pure gold: asya beaten work shall bi candlestick bhū vidh: asya shaft, ù ani branches, bi bowls, ani knops, u3 ani flowers, shall bhū asya bi same.
tathā six branches shall è bahis ak sa sides sya ne; three branches sya bi candlestick è asya sa diš side, ù three branches sya bi candlestick bahis sya bi other side:

three bowls nirmā like prati almonds, da a knop ca a flower ša prathama branch; u3 three bowls dim like almonds ša sa other branch, saha a knop ù a flower: evam a bi six branches ne du bāhya sya eṣa candlestick.
ca a bi candlestick shall gál four bowls gag like abhimukham almonds, ù bi-meš knops api bi-meš flowers.

tathā ni shall gál a knop ki-ta min branches ak tad same, tathā a knop nīce dvau branches sya bi same, ù a knop nīce dvi branches ak sa same, according šè sa six branches tad proceed è ak tad candlestick.
bi-meš knops ù teṣām branches shall gál ak eṣa same: sarva idam shall as prathama beaten work asya pure gold.
ca thou shalt dù tad seven lamps thereof: ca they shall prakāśa bi lamps thereof, iri they may give prakāśa over against bi.
ca eṣa tongs thereof, u3 bi snuffdishes thereof, shall vṛt ak pure gold.
ak a talent ak pure gold shall sa dù tat, ù sarva these vessels.
tathā look yad thou kṛ tān after eṣām pattern, yaḥ as shewed thee ša sa mount.
moreover thou shalt nirmā bi tabernacle da ten curtains sya fine twined linen, u3 blue, u3 purple, ù scarlet: da cherubims ak cunning work shalt thou vidh etān.
bi length ak aš curtain shall bhū eight api twenty cubits, ù tad breadth ak eka curtain four cubits: ù every aš sya bi curtains shall have aš measure.
sa five curtains shall me coupled saṃyuktam aš abhimukham another; u3 other five curtains shall bhū coupled eka prati another.
u3 thou shalt kṛ loops ak blue ugu tad edge asya bi diš curtain tas tad selvedge ša bi coupling; u3 likewise shalt thou nirmā ša tad uttermost edge ak another curtain, madhye sa coupling ak bi 2-kam.
fifty loops shalt thou vidh a sa eka curtain, api fifty loops shalt thou dim madhye bi edge asya bi curtain tad is ša bi coupling asya bi dvi; yad bi loops may take hold diš ak another.
ù thou shalt gag fifty taches asya gold, ù couple bi curtains ús sahita bi taches: api bi shall gál diš tabernacle.
u3 thou shalt vidh curtains ak goats' hair šè bhū a covering upari bi tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou kṛ.
bi length sya diš curtain shall as thirty cubits, ù eṣa breadth ak eka curtain four cubits: ca bi eleven curtains shall gál sakala sya eka measure.
ù thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, u3 six curtains by themselves, u3 shalt double eṣa sixth curtain ša sa forefront ak tad tabernacle.
tathā thou shalt dim fifty loops on bi edge ak sa aš curtain yad is outmost madhye bi coupling, ca fifty loops ša bi edge ak eṣa curtain yad coupleth bi 2-kam.
u3 thou shalt kṛ fifty taches ak brass, ù put eṣa taches antar bi loops, u3 couple tad tent ús, yad ne may gál eka.
tathā bi remnant yad remaineth asya tad curtains sya bi tent, bi half curtain ne remaineth, shall hang over bi backside ak bi tabernacle.

tathā a cubit on sa diš side, tathā a cubit on bi other side sya ne lú remaineth a tad length ak sa curtains ak tad tent, bi shall hang over bi sides asya bi tabernacle on etat side u3 on tad side, šè cover tat.
ca thou shalt vidh a covering arthạm eṣa tent sya rams' skins dyed red, api a covering an-ta asya badgers' skins.
ù thou shalt gag boards kṛte eṣa tabernacle asya shittim wood standing up.
ten cubits shall bhū eṣa length sya a board, ù a cubit api a half shall me tad breadth sya aš board.
min tenons shall tatra as madhye prathama board, set madhye order aš against another: thus shalt thou gag arthạm šu bi boards sya eṣa tabernacle.
ù thou shalt nirmā bi boards mu bi tabernacle, twenty boards on bi south side southward.
u3 thou shalt gag forty sockets ak silver kur bi twenty boards; min sockets kur eka board šè bi dvi tenons, u3 dvi sockets kur another board mu ani dvau tenons.
ù šè eṣa min side ak bi tabernacle on bi north side ne shall bhū twenty boards:
ca bi-meš forty sockets asya silver; min sockets nīce eka board, ca min sockets adhas another board.
tathā šè eṣa sides ak sa tabernacle westward thou shalt dù six boards.
ù min boards shalt thou dù kṛte eṣa corners asya tad tabernacle antar bi dvau sides.
u3 they shall vṛt coupled niĝin beneath, ù they shall gál coupled niĝin ugu bi head ak idam prati eka ring: thus shall ne me mu bi-ne both; they shall gál arthạm bi dvi corners.
u3 they shall as eight boards, ù teṣām sockets ak silver, sixteen sockets; dvau sockets ki-ta prathama board, ù min sockets kur another board.
u3 thou shalt vidh bars asya shittim wood; five mu eṣa boards ak bi prathama side asya tad tabernacle,
api five bars kṛte sa boards asya bi other side sya sa tabernacle, api five bars mu bi boards ak sa side asya bi tabernacle, šè bi dvi sides westward.
u3 sa middle bar a eṣa madhya sya bi boards shall reach ta end prati end.
api thou shalt overlay bi boards da gold, u3 gag bi-meš rings ak gold šè places mu tad bars: ca thou shalt overlay bi bars sahita gold.
ù thou shalt rear up sa tabernacle according abhimukham bi fashion thereof ša bhū shewed thee madhye bi mount.
tathā thou shalt gag a vail sya blue, tathā purple, u3 scarlet, u3 fine twined linen asya cunning work: da cherubims shall ne vṛt nirmā:
api thou shalt hang bi ugu four pillars asya shittim wood overlaid da gold: bi-meš hooks shall me asya gold, par bi four sockets ak silver.
ù thou shalt hang up sa vail ki-ta sa taches, iri thou mayest bring ša thither within tad vail bi ark ak bi testimony: tathā eṣa vail shall chid prati you between eṣa holy deśa ù eṣa most holy.
ca thou shalt put sa mercy seat ugu bi ark asya bi testimony antar bi most holy ki.
u3 thou shalt set bi table nu eṣa vail, api bi candlestick over against bi table on bi side asya bi tabernacle toward sa south: ù thou shalt put bi table on bi north side.
ù thou shalt dim an hanging arthạm tad door asya tad tent, ak blue, ca purple, u3 scarlet, api fine twined linen, wrought ù needlework.
ù thou shalt vidh arthạm tad hanging five pillars ak shittim wood, api overlay etān saha gold, tathā bi-meš hooks shall gál sya gold: ù thou shalt cast five sockets ak brass arthạm etān.
ù thou shalt vidh an altar sya shittim wood, five cubits long, ù five cubits broad; bi altar shall gál foursquare: ù eṣa height thereof shall as three cubits.
u3 thou shalt nirmā bi horns asya ne par eṣa four corners thereof: ani horns shall vṛt ak tad same: tathā thou shalt overlay bi ù brass.
api thou shalt kṛ ani pans šè receive ani ashes, ca tasya shovels, ca ani basons, api asya fleshhooks, tathā bi firepans: sakala bi vessels thereof thou shalt dim sya brass.
api thou shalt gag mu tat a grate ak network ak brass; tathā šu-ba bi net shalt thou dù four brasen rings madhye bi four corners thereof.
u3 thou shalt put tat adhas bi compass sya tad altar beneath, yad sa net may gál even šè eṣa murgu ak bi altar.
u3 thou shalt dù staves arthạm sa altar, staves ak shittim wood, u3 overlay bi-ne da brass.
u3 bi staves shall as put antar bi rings, ù tad staves shall gál ugu bi dvau sides asya sa altar, abhimukham bear ne.
hollow ù boards shalt thou kṛ tat: as ne as shewed thee ša tad mount, evam shall they nirmā ne.
ca thou shalt vidh eṣa court sya eṣa tabernacle: mu bi south side southward atra shall gál hangings arthạm bi court sya fine twined linen asya an hundred cubits long kṛte eka side:
api bi twenty pillars thereof u3 bi-meš twenty sockets shall gál asya brass; tad hooks ak sa pillars ca bi-meš fillets shall me ak silver.

u3 likewise arthạm bi north side antar length tatra shall gál hangings asya an hundred cubits long, api asya twenty pillars ù bi-meš twenty sockets sya brass; bi hooks ak eṣa pillars tathā bi-meš fillets ak silver.
api arthạm sa breadth asya bi court on tad west side shall me hangings ak fifty cubits: bi-meš pillars ten, ca bi-meš sockets ten.
ù bi breadth ak bi court on eṣa east side eastward shall as fifty cubits.
bi hangings sya diš side asya bi gate shall vṛt fifteen cubits: teṣām pillars three, api eṣām sockets three.
u3 on bi other side shall vṛt hangings fifteen cubits: bi-meš pillars three, ù eṣām sockets three.

ù arthạm tad gate ak sa court shall gál an hanging ak twenty cubits, sya blue, u3 purple, u3 scarlet, u3 fine twined linen, wrought saha needlework: ù bi-meš pillars shall gál four, api bi-meš sockets four.
niĝ bi pillars round about sa court shall as filleted saha silver; bi-meš hooks shall vṛt sya silver, ù teṣām sockets ak brass.
bi length ak eṣa court shall gál an hundred cubits, ù tad breadth fifty every where, api eṣa height five cubits sya fine twined linen, ù bi-meš sockets ak brass.
šu tad vessels sya sa tabernacle madhye niĝ tad service thereof, u3 sarva sa pins thereof, api sarva sa pins ak bi court, shall me ak brass.
ca thou shalt command sa children sya israel, iri they bring thee pure oil olive beaten kṛte eṣa bànda, šè cause eṣa lamp abhimukham burn always.

madhye eṣa tabernacle ak bi congregation rahita bi vail, lú is before tad testimony, aaron api asya putra shall order idam tas sig-ge6 prati prātas before bi ensi: ne shall gál a statute kṛte ever prati eṣām generations on bi behalf asya bi children asya israel.

u3 take thou abhimukham thee aaron thy brother, tathā ani suta saha him, ta among bi children asya israel, tad ani may minister abhimukham me antar bi priest's office, even aaron, nadab u3 abihu, eleazar ca ithamar, aaron's ātmaja.
ù thou shalt dù holy garments kṛte aaron thy brother kṛte glory u3 šè beauty.

u3 thou shalt speak abhimukham šu yad are wise hearted, whom i have filled saha tad zi sya wisdom, tad they may dim aaron's garments prati consecrate him, iri ayam may minister šè me madhye bi priest's office.

u3 these are eṣa garments yad they shall vidh; a breastplate, api an ephod, api a robe, ù a broidered coat, a mitre, ù a girdle: tathā they shall kṛ holy garments mu aaron thy brother, ca bi ātmaja, tad sa may minister abhimukham me madhye bi priest's office.
ca they shall take gold, u3 blue, api purple, u3 scarlet, api fine linen.
api they shall kṛ bi ephod ak gold, sya blue, u3 sya purple, asya scarlet, ù fine twined linen, sahita cunning work.
tat shall have tad min shoulderpieces thereof joined at bi min edges thereof; tathā ga-nam bi shall vṛt joined saṃyuktam.
tathā bi curious girdle asya sa ephod, lú is šu-ba idam, shall bhū ak bi same, according šè sa work thereof; even ak gold, sya blue, ù purple, api scarlet, ù fine twined linen.
tathā thou shalt take min onyx stones, u3 grave on bi-ne eṣa names ak bi children sya israel:
six sya eṣām names on aš stone, ù sa other six names ak bi rest on bi other stone, according abhimukham teṣām birth.
da bi work sya an engraver ša stone, like tad engravings ak a signet, shalt thou engrave bi min stones saha tad names sya tad children ak israel: thou shalt gag bi-ne šè gál set antar ouches ak gold.

u3 thou shalt put bi dvi stones ugu tad shoulders asya bi ephod mu stones asya memorial šè sa children ak israel: ù aaron shall bear bi-meš names before bi ensi ugu ani min shoulders arthạm a memorial.
ù thou shalt kṛ ouches sya gold;
tathā min chains asya pure gold at bi ends; ak wreathen work shalt thou gag bi-ne, tathā fasten eṣa wreathen chains šè sa ouches.

ù thou shalt gag eṣa breastplate ak judgment da cunning work; after bi work ak sa ephod thou shalt gag tat; asya gold, ak blue, u3 asya purple, ca ak scarlet, ca ak fine twined linen, shalt thou nirmā tat.
foursquare idam shall me being doubled; a span shall vṛt eṣa length thereof, ca a span shall gál bi breadth thereof.
api thou shalt set ša idam settings sya stones, even four rows ak stones: bi prathama row shall bhū a sardius, a topaz, ù a carbuncle: etat shall as bi prathama row.
api eṣa dvitīya row shall gál an emerald, a sapphire, ca a diamond.
u3 eṣa eš row a ligure, an agate, ù an amethyst.
api eṣa fourth row a beryl, tathā an onyx, ca a jasper: they shall gál set madhye gold ša teṣām inclosings.

ù bi stones shall gál saha eṣa names ak bi children sya israel, twelve, according šè teṣām names, like sa engravings ak a signet; every aš ù ani name shall they gál according abhimukham bi twelve tribes.
ca thou shalt nirmā par sa breastplate chains at eṣa ends sya wreathen work sya pure gold.
ù thou shalt vidh šu-ba bi breastplate dvau rings sya gold, u3 shalt put bi min rings on bi min ends sya bi breastplate.
ù thou shalt put tad min wreathen chains sya gold madhye sa min rings lú are on bi ends ak bi breastplate.
ù eṣa other dvi ends ak bi dvi wreathen chains thou shalt fasten ša bi dvi ouches, ù put bi-ne on tad shoulderpieces ak bi ephod before ne.
u3 thou shalt nirmā dvi rings ak gold, u3 thou shalt put etān upari sa min ends sya sa breastplate antar bi border thereof, yaḥ is antar sa side ak bi ephod inward.

u3 dvau other rings asya gold thou shalt vidh, tathā shalt put bi-ne on bi dvi sides ak bi ephod underneath, toward bi forepart thereof, over against tad other coupling thereof, upari sa curious girdle ak bi ephod.

tathā they shall bind sa breastplate by sa rings thereof šè bi rings asya bi ephod ù a lace ak blue, ne idam may bhū upari bi curious girdle ak bi ephod, tathā ne eṣa breastplate bhū na loosed prabhṛti bi ephod.
u3 aaron shall bear eṣa names asya tad children sya israel madhye sa breastplate asya judgment upari bi heart, when bi goeth madhye abhimukham bi holy ki, šè a memorial before bi lugal continually.

api thou shalt put a sa breastplate ak judgment bi urim u3 bi thummim; tathā they shall me ugu aaron's heart, when sa goeth ša before bi svāmin: api aaron shall bear bi judgment asya bi children ak israel upari tasya heart before sa lugal continually.
tathā thou shalt kṛ eṣa robe sya bi ephod šu ak blue.
ù atra shall bhū an hole a sa top sya ne, a bi murgu thereof: ne shall have a binding sya woven work round about bi hole sya bi, as bi me tad hole asya an habergeon, ne ne bhū na rent.
u3 beneath par tad hem asya ne thou shalt dù pomegranates asya blue, ca asya purple, api asya scarlet, round about bi hem thereof; tathā bells asya gold between bi-ne round about:
a golden bell u3 a pomegranate, a golden bell ù a pomegranate, par sa hem ak bi robe round about.
u3 idam shall as par aaron šè minister: api ani sound shall gál heard when eṣa goeth ša šè tad holy sthāna before bi en, ù when sa cometh bar, iri eṣa kāl nu.
tathā thou shalt dù a plate sya pure gold, api grave šu-ba bi, like sa engravings asya a signet, holiness šè eṣa svāmin.
u3 thou shalt put tat on a blue lace, iri tat may gál par sa mitre; upari bi forefront asya bi mitre bi shall me.

ù tat shall me upari aaron's forehead, yad aaron may bear sa iniquity ak sa holy things, yad sa children ak israel shall hallow madhye sakala teṣām holy gifts; u3 idam shall me always ugu tasya forehead, yad they may me accepted before bi prabhu.
ù thou shalt embroider eṣa coat asya fine linen, tathā thou shalt gag sa mitre ak fine linen, tathā thou shalt nirmā bi girdle ak needlework.
ù kṛte aaron's ibila thou shalt vidh coats, u3 thou shalt gag mu etān girdles, u3 bonnets shalt thou kṛ šè bi-ne, šè glory ù šè beauty.
api thou shalt put etān ugu aaron thy brother, ù asya putra saha him; u3 shalt anoint tān, u3 consecrate bi-ne, tathā sanctify tān, iri they may minister šè me madhye sa priest's office.
ca thou shalt vidh bi-ne linen breeches šè cover eṣām nakedness; prabhṛti tad loins even šè bi thighs they shall reach:

u3 they shall vṛt par aaron, ù upari tasya suta, when they prāp antar abhimukham sa tabernacle asya bi congregation, or when they du near šè bi altar abhimukham minister antar bi holy deśa; ne they bear nu iniquity, ca pralī: idam shall vṛt a statute kṛte ever šè him ca asya seed after him.
api ne is eṣa thing ne thou shalt do šè tān prati hallow etān, prati minister prati me antar bi priest's office: take prathama young bullock, ù min rams vinā blemish,
u3 unleavened bread, u3 cakes unleavened tempered ù oil, tathā wafers unleavened anointed da oil: ak wheaten flour shalt thou dù etān.
tathā thou shalt put bi-ne a aš basket, u3 bring tān ša bi basket, da sa bullock ù eṣa dvau rams.
ù aaron tathā ani dumu thou shalt bring abhimukham sa door ak tad tabernacle sya bi congregation, ù shalt wash bi-ne sahita jala.
tathā thou shalt take tad garments, ù put ugu aaron bi coat, api bi robe ak bi ephod, u3 bi ephod, tathā bi breastplate, u3 gird him saha sa curious girdle sya eṣa ephod:
api thou shalt put bi mitre upari tasya head, u3 put eṣa holy crown upari bi mitre.
then shalt thou take bi anointing oil, api pour idam par ani head, ù anoint him.
u3 thou shalt bring tasya dumu, ù put coats ugu bi-ne.
u3 thou shalt gird etān saha girdles, aaron u3 tasya putra, ù put eṣa bonnets on bi-ne: u3 bi priest's office shall gál theirs šè a perpetual statute: ù thou shalt consecrate aaron ca asya ibila.
ca thou shalt cause a bullock abhimukham vṛt brought before tad tabernacle asya bi congregation: tathā aaron u3 ani dumu shall put teṣām hands ugu bi head ak bi bullock.
tathā thou shalt kill bi bullock before bi nātha, by eṣa door ak sa tabernacle ak sa congregation.
ù thou shalt take sya eṣa blood sya bi bullock, ù put ne ugu eṣa horns sya bi altar ù thy finger, ca pour niĝ bi blood beside sa bottom sya sa altar.
ù thou shalt take gištug eṣa fat iri covereth bi inwards, ca bi caul ne is ūrdhva bi liver, ù bi min kidneys, api eṣa fat tad is upari etān, api burn bi-ne par eṣa altar.
but sa flesh ak sa bullock, u3 bi skin, ù bi dung, shalt thou burn saha fire ul eṣa camp: idam is a sin offering.
thou shalt also take aš ram; tathā aaron ù asya suta shall put bi-meš hands šu-ba eṣa head ak tad ram.
u3 thou shalt slay bi ram, tathā thou shalt take ani blood, u3 sprinkle tat round about šu-ba sa altar.
u3 thou shalt cut bi ram a pieces, ù wash bi inwards asya him, tathā tasya legs, u3 put etān prati asya pieces, u3 abhimukham asya head.
api thou shalt burn bi whole ram par bi altar: ne is a burnt offering abhimukham sa nātha: bi is a sweet savour, an offering gag by fire šè bi lugal.
tathā thou shalt take bi other ram; ù aaron api ani dumu shall put bi-meš hands par sa head ak tad ram.

then shalt thou kill bi ram, ù take ak bi blood, ca put tat šu-ba eṣa tip ak sa right ear sya aaron, u3 šu-ba bi tip ak eṣa right ear asya asya ātmaja, ca upari sa thumb sya bi-meš right hand, u3 par bi mah toe sya eṣām right foot, u3 sprinkle sa blood šu-ba tad altar round about.

ca thou shalt take sya bi blood iri is par bi altar, ù sya bi anointing oil, ù sprinkle idam par aaron, u3 ugu ani garments, u3 šu-ba tasya suta, ca šu-ba bi garments ak asya dumu da him: ca ani shall as hallowed, ca tasya garments, api ani dumu, u3 ani sons' garments saha him.

also thou shalt take ak sa ram bi fat tathā bi rump, ù tad fat yad covereth bi inwards, api eṣa caul ugu bi liver, api bi min kidneys, ca sa fat yad is par etān, ù bi right shoulder; kṛte bi is a ram sya consecration:
ù diš loaf ak bread, tathā eka cake sya oiled bread, ca prathama wafer bar ak bi basket asya tad unleavened bread ne is before sa prabhu:
tathā thou shalt put šu antar tad hands sya aaron, u3 a eṣa hands asya ani ātmaja; u3 shalt wave etān šè a wave offering before bi en.
ù thou shalt receive etān sya bi-meš hands, ù burn bi-ne par bi altar kṛte a burnt offering, arthạm a sweet savour before tad svāmin: ne is an offering kṛ by fire šè eṣa ensi.
u3 thou shalt take bi breast ak tad ram ak aaron's consecration, u3 wave tat arthạm a wave offering before eṣa nātha: api tat shall me thy part.

ca thou shalt sanctify bi breast ak bi wave offering, ca eṣa shoulder ak tad heave offering, ša is waved, ca yaḥ is heaved up, ak eṣa ram sya tad consecration, even asya ne yaḥ is arthạm aaron, u3 sya yad yad is arthạm tasya putra:

u3 idam shall gál aaron's u3 ani sons' by a statute mu ever ta bi children ak israel: mu idam is an heave offering: api idam shall as an heave offering ta bi children ak israel ak eṣa sacrifice asya bi-meš peace offerings, even bi-meš heave offering prati tad prabhu.
u3 eṣa holy garments ak aaron shall as bi sons' after him, abhimukham me anointed therein, api šè bhū consecrated antar bi-ne.
ù ne suta iri is priest antar ani stead shall put tān on seven days, when ayam cometh a bi tabernacle asya bi congregation abhimukham minister antar bi holy šà.
ca thou shalt take bi ram asya bi consecration, ù seethe tasya flesh a tad holy sthāna.
u3 aaron ù asya ātmaja shall eat bi flesh ak sa ram, tathā tad bread yad is madhye tad basket, by bi door ak bi tabernacle asya bi congregation.
ù they shall eat those things wherewith sa atonement as dù, abhimukham consecrate tathā šè sanctify bi-ne: but a stranger shall ul eat thereof, because they are holy.
tathā if ought ak bi flesh ak eṣa consecrations, or asya tad bread, remain abhimukham sa u4-ul-li, then thou shalt burn bi remainder saha fire: ne shall na as eaten, because tat is holy.
u3 thus shalt thou do abhimukham aaron, u3 šè asya ibila, according prati gištug things ša i have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate bi-ne.
u3 thou shalt offer every ahar a bullock kṛte a sin offering arthạm atonement: tathā thou shalt cleanse bi altar, when thou hast dim an atonement šè tat, u3 thou shalt anoint idam, šè sanctify idam.
seven days thou shalt dù an atonement mu eṣa altar, api sanctify idam; tathā idam shall me an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth bi altar shall vṛt holy.
now idam is iri lú thou shalt offer upari bi altar; dvau lambs ak bi prathama year ud by divasa continually.
bi aš lamb thou shalt offer madhye tad prātas; ca bi other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
ca saha bi eka lamb a tenth deal asya flour mingled da bi fourth part ak an hin sya beaten oil; api tad fourth part ak an hin ak wine šè a drink offering.

ca tad other lamb thou shalt offer at even, u3 shalt do thereto according prati bi meat offering asya eṣa u4-ul-li, u3 according šè bi drink offering thereof, arthạm a sweet savour, an offering dù by fire abhimukham bi ensi.
etat shall vṛt a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at bi door ak eṣa tabernacle sya bi congregation before bi lugal: where i will meet you, abhimukham speak ni abhimukham thee.
u3 ne i will meet da eṣa children sya israel, tathā bi tabernacle shall gál sanctified by my glory.
ù i will sanctify bi tabernacle ak tad congregation, tathā eṣa altar: i will sanctify also both aaron u3 tasya ibila, šè minister abhimukham me madhye bi priest's office.
u3 i will dwell among eṣa children asya israel, api will as bi-meš ilum.
tathā they shall know tad i am eṣa lugal teṣām dingir, tad brought etān forth bāhya ak sa kalam asya egypt, ne i may dwell among bi-ne: i am bi prabhu teṣām deva.
tathā thou shalt nirmā an altar šè burn incense ugu: sya shittim wood shalt thou gag tat.
a cubit shall me bi length thereof, ca a cubit bi breadth thereof; foursquare shall tat gál: api dvau cubits shall vṛt bi height thereof: bi horns thereof shall bhū ak bi same.
tathā thou shalt overlay idam ù pure gold, sa top thereof, ca eṣa sides thereof round about, ca tad horns thereof; ù thou shalt vidh prati bi a crown sya gold round about.

api dvau golden rings shalt thou nirmā abhimukham tat adhas eṣa crown asya tat, by bi dvau corners thereof, upari bi dvau sides ak ne shalt thou kṛ bi; ù they shall gál kṛte places kṛte sa staves prati bear tat withal.
ù thou shalt nirmā eṣa staves sya shittim wood, ù overlay etān da gold.
u3 thou shalt put ne before tad vail iri is by bi ark asya eṣa testimony, before bi mercy seat tad is over sa testimony, where i will meet saha thee.
ca aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every prātas: when ani dresseth bi lamps, bi shall burn incense šu-ba idam.
ù when aaron lighteth bi lamps at even, ani shall burn incense upari bi, a perpetual incense before tad prabhu throughout your generations.
ye shall offer nu strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

api aaron shall dù an atonement šu-ba sa horns ak ne once antar a year da bi blood ak bi sin offering asya atonements: once madhye sa year shall ani nirmā atonement par idam throughout your generations: ne is most holy abhimukham tad en.
api tad svāmin spake šè moses, brū,

when thou takest bi sum ak bi children sya israel after bi-meš number, then shall they give every nara a ransom arthạm asya soul abhimukham bi nātha, when thou numberest bi-ne; ne ni me na plague among tān, when thou numberest tān.

etat they shall give, every diš ne passeth among bi-ne yad are numbered, half a shekel after tad shekel asya bi sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs :) an half shekel shall vṛt bi offering sya bi nātha.
every diš iri passeth among etān iri are numbered, ta twenty years old u3 upari, shall give an offering šè eṣa prabhu.
bi rich shall nu give more, ù sa poor shall ul give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering šè bi lugal, šè kṛ an atonement mu your souls.

u3 thou shalt take bi atonement money ak bi children sya israel, ca shalt appoint idam kṛte sa service ak bi tabernacle ak sa congregation; tad tat may bhū a memorial prati bi children sya israel before sa lugal, šè gag an atonement kṛte your souls.
api eṣa prabhu spake prati moses, kathay,
thou shalt also dim a laver ak brass, u3 bi foot also ak brass, prati wash withal: ca thou shalt put ne between eṣa tabernacle ak sa congregation u3 tad altar, tathā thou shalt put ídim therein.
arthạm aaron u3 asya ibila shall wash teṣām hands ca bi-meš feet thereat:
when they è a bi tabernacle sya bi congregation, they shall wash sahita jala, yad they kāl mā; or when they è near šè tad altar prati minister, abhimukham burn offering dim by fire šè bi nātha:
ittham they shall wash teṣām hands api eṣām feet, yad they úš mā: tathā bi shall me a statute arthạm ever abhimukham tān, even abhimukham him u3 šè ani seed throughout eṣām generations.
moreover tad prabhu spake šè moses, vac,

take thou also šè thee principal spices, sya pure myrrh five hundred shekels, tathā sya sweet cinnamon half nu-me much, even min hundred api fifty shekels, u3 sya sweet calamus dvi hundred u3 fifty shekels,
api ak cassia five hundred shekels, after bi shekel ak bi sanctuary, ca ak oil olive an hin:
ca thou shalt dim idam an oil ak holy ointment, an ointment compound after bi art sya bi apothecary: tat shall as an holy anointing oil.
u3 thou shalt anoint eṣa tabernacle asya bi congregation therewith, ca bi ark sya tad testimony,
tathā tad table tathā šu tasya vessels, ù bi candlestick ca asya vessels, ù bi altar ak incense,
tathā eṣa altar ak burnt offering sahita niĝ tasya vessels, tathā bi laver tathā tasya foot.
ù thou shalt sanctify bi-ne, iri they may vṛt most holy: whatsoever toucheth bi-ne shall gál holy.
ca thou shalt anoint aaron u3 asya ibila, u3 consecrate bi-ne, yad they may minister prati me antar eṣa priest's office.
u3 thou shalt speak šè tad children asya israel, e, etat shall as an holy anointing oil šè me throughout your generations.
par man's flesh shall idam nu me poured, neither shall ye dim any other like tat, after tad composition sya idam: bi is holy, tathā idam shall me holy šè you.
whosoever compoundeth any like ne, or whosoever putteth any ak idam ugu a stranger, shall even as cut off ta bi loka.
tathā bi nātha inim šè moses, take šè thee sweet spices, stacte, u3 onycha, ca galbanum; these sweet spices saha pure frankincense: asya each shall tatra me a like weight:
u3 thou shalt dù idam a perfume, a confection after bi art asya bi apothecary, tempered saha, pure ù holy:
u3 thou shalt beat some ak ne very small, api put sya ne before bi testimony antar eṣa tabernacle ak tad congregation, where i will meet saha thee: bi shall gál abhimukham you most holy.
ù as kṛte bi perfume ša thou shalt dim, ye shall ul kṛ abhimukham yourselves according šè bi composition thereof: idam shall me prati thee holy kṛte sa svāmin.
whosoever shall dù like šè yad, šè smell thereto, shall even me cut off ta tasya prajā.
tathā bi prabhu spake šè moses, dug4,
bar, i have gu3-dé by name bezaleel eṣa ibila ak uri, bi ātmaja ak hur, ak bi tribe asya judah:
api i have filled him sahita eṣa an-zu sya ilum, antar wisdom, ù madhye understanding, ca madhye knowledge, u3 ša sarva manner asya workmanship,
šè devise cunning works, šè work a gold, u3 a silver, ca madhye brass,
ù antar cutting sya stones, abhimukham set tān, ù antar carving ak timber, šè work ša gištug manner sya workmanship.

u3 i, behold, i have given saha him aholiab, eṣa putra ak ahisamach, sya bi tribe ak dan: ca antar sa hearts ak sarva iri are wise hearted i have put wisdom, iri they may gag šu yad i have commanded thee;
eṣa tabernacle ak bi congregation, tathā bi ark asya bi testimony, u3 bi mercy seat yad is thereupon, ù gištug bi furniture sya bi tabernacle,
ca eṣa table api tasya furniture, ù bi pure candlestick saha šu bi furniture, api eṣa altar ak incense,
ù sa altar ak burnt offering sahita sakala asya furniture, ù bi laver tathā bi foot,
tathā bi cloths ak service, ù bi holy garments arthạm aaron bi priest, tathā eṣa garments asya tasya dumu, prati minister a tad priest's office,
u3 bi anointing oil, ca sweet incense mu bi holy sthāna: according abhimukham niĝ iri i have commanded thee shall they do.
ù sa svāmin spake šè moses, inim,

speak thou also prati bi children sya israel, e, verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: šè idam is a sign between me ù you throughout your generations; ne ye may know tad i am bi ensi tad doth sanctify you.

ye shall keep tad sabbath therefore; kṛte ne is holy abhimukham you: every eka iri defileth ne shall surely me put šè mṛtyu: arthạm whosoever doeth any work therein, ne soul shall as cut off prabhṛti among asya jana.
six days may work as done; but a bi seventh is eṣa sabbath ak rest, holy šè bi nātha: whosoever doeth any work madhye bi sabbath divasa, ani shall surely bhū put abhimukham maraṇa.
wherefore bi children sya israel shall keep eṣa sabbath, šè observe tad sabbath throughout teṣām generations, arthạm a perpetual covenant.
bi is a sign between me tathā bi children sya israel mu ever: arthạm ša six days eṣa nātha vidh dyau api ki, u3 on tad seventh u4 ani rested, u3 as refreshed.
u3 sa gave šè moses, when eṣa had vidh an end ak communing da him upari mount sinai, dvi tables asya testimony, tables ak stone, written ù bi finger ak an.

u3 when tad jana lok iri moses delayed šè du down bar ak bi mount, eṣa ukkin šum themselves niĝin prati aaron, u3 e prati him, up, dim us gods, yaḥ shall gen before us; arthạm as kṛte bi moses, bi nitadam tad brought us up bahis ak bi deśa ak egypt, we wot ul what is become ak him.
api aaron vac abhimukham tān, break off bi golden earrings, yad are madhye bi ears ak your wives, asya your dumu, tathā ak your daughters, ca bring tān abhimukham me.
api gištug tad loka brake off bi golden earrings lú me ša bi-meš ears, u3 brought bi-ne šè aaron.

tathā ayam received bi-ne at bi-meš hand, u3 fashioned bi ù a graving tool, after ani had vidh tat a molten calf: ca they vac, these me thy gods, o israel, ša brought thee up bar sya eṣa pradeśa ak egypt.
ca when aaron paś tat, sa built an altar before ne; ca aaron nirmā proclamation, ù vac, šè morrow is a feast šè sa lugal.
tathā they rose up early on tad morrow, api offered burnt offerings, api brought peace offerings; tathā tad ùĝ sat down šè eat ca abhimukham drink, ù rose up prati play.
tathā bi ensi inim abhimukham moses, du, get thee down; mu thy prajā, lú thou broughtest bahis ak tad kur asya egypt, have corrupted themselves:

they have turned aside quickly bahis sya bi way yad i commanded tān: they have dim etān a molten calf, ù have worshipped idam, ù have sacrificed thereunto, u3 e, these gál thy gods, o israel, ša have brought thee up bāhya ak bi deśa ak egypt.
api bi nātha inim prati moses, i have bar bi ùĝ, tathā, behold, bi is a stiffnecked loka:
now therefore gá me alone, tad my wrath may wax hot against bi-ne, u3 tad i may consume bi-ne: api i will dim ak thee a gu-la nation.
ù moses besought eṣa en bi deva, tathā kathay, lugal, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy saĝ, yad thou hast brought forth bahis asya tad deśa ak egypt da mah power, ù sahita a mighty hand?

wherefore should sa egyptians speak, ù dug4, kṛte mischief did sa bring tān bar, šè slay bi-ne madhye bi mountains, u3 abhimukham consume bi-ne ta tad pa ak bi pṛthivī? turn ta thy fierce wrath, api repent sya bi evil against thy saĝ.

remember abraham, isaac, api israel, thy servants, šè whom thou swarest by thine own self, u3 saidst prati bi-ne, i will multiply your seed as tad stars ak naka, ù šu idam kur tad i have spoken sya will i give šè your seed, api they shall inherit bi šè ever.
ù bi ensi repented ak bi evil yad ayam thought šè do prati asya prajā.
u3 moses turned, api vraj down ta eṣa mount, ù bi min tables ak tad testimony gál ša asya hand: eṣa tables gál written on both teṣām sides; on bi diš side u3 on tad other me they written.
api bi tables vṛt sa work sya bhagavān, ù tad writing me bi writing sya ilum, graven ugu sa tables.
ca when joshua heard bi noise ak bi ùĝ as they shouted, bi vac šè moses, ni is a noise asya war madhye sa camp.
ù sa inim, bi is na eṣa voice sya etān iri shout arthạm mastery, neither is bi bi voice ak tān iri cry šè being overcome: but bi noise ak bi-ne yad sing do i hear.
ù bi è prati pass, as soon as eṣa ā-gam nigh šè bi camp, ne bi bar bi calf, tathā eṣa dancing: ù moses' anger waxed hot, u3 ani cast bi tables bāhya sya bi hands, ca brake etān beneath tad mount.
tathā sa took bi calf ša they had kṛ, u3 burnt tat ša sa fire, ù ground tat abhimukham powder, ca strawed ne par bi udaka, tathā dù bi children asya israel drink ak idam.
u3 moses vac šè aaron, what did bi ukkin prati thee, tad thou hast brought evam mahā a sin upari bi-ne?
u3 aaron inim, he-me na bi anger ak my ensi wax hot: thou knowest bi jana, tad they are set on mischief.
kṛte they inim prati me, vidh us gods, yaḥ shall gam before us: mu as šè etat moses, sa manuṣya ne brought us up è ak bi bhū ak egypt, we wot ul what is become asya him.
ù i dug4 prati bi-ne, whosoever hath any gold, dā bi-ne break idam off. evam they gave tat me: then i cast ne šè bi fire, u3 ne gin bāhya bi calf.
ca when moses bar yad sa prajā vṛt naked; (for aaron had gag bi-ne naked šè teṣām shame among bi-meš enemies :)
then moses stood antar sa gate ak sa camp, api brū, who is on bi lord's side? dā him gin šè me. tathā šu bi ātmaja ak levi sañcay themselves saha šè him.

ù ayam brū šè bi-ne, thus saith bi en ilum asya israel, put every puruṣa asya sword by ani side, tathā gen a ca bar ta gate abhimukham gate throughout tad camp, ù slay every nara tasya brother, ca every nitadam tasya companion, api every lú ani neighbour.
u3 bi children ak levi did according šè sa word asya moses: ca ni fell ak bi loka tad ud about three thousand men.
kṛte moses had brū, consecrate yourselves today prati eṣa ensi, even every nitadam par tasya putra, api šu-ba bi brother; iri ani may bestow upari you a blessing bi ud.
tathā bi āyā abhimukham pass on bi morrow, iri moses inim šè sa prajā, ye have sinned a bṛhat sin: u3 now i will vraj up prati bi nātha; peradventure i shall gag an atonement kṛte your sin.
u3 moses returned abhimukham bi prabhu, tathā kathay, oh, etat ukkin have sinned a gal sin, tathā have nirmā bi-ne gods ak gold.
yet now, if thou wilt forgive teṣām sin--; api if nu, blot me, i pray thee, bāhya ak thy book yad thou hast written.
ca eṣa lugal kathay prati moses, whosoever hath sinned against me, him will i blot bar ak my book.
therefore now gen, lead bi ukkin abhimukham bi ki ak ša i have spoken šè thee: behold, mine angel shall du before thee: nevertheless ša eṣa dina when i visit i will visit bi-meš sin upari etān.
tathā bi en plagued tad ukkin, because they nirmā bi calf, lú aaron dù.

ù bi ensi brū abhimukham moses, depart, u3 è up hence, thou tathā tad ukkin yad thou hast brought up bar ak eṣa kalam asya egypt, prati bi kalam ša i sware abhimukham abraham, abhimukham isaac, ù šè jacob, vac, prati thy seed will i give ne:
ù i will send an angel before thee; ù i will drive bar eṣa canaanite, tad amorite, ù sa hittite, u3 eṣa perizzite, bi hivite, ca bi jebusite:
šè a kalam flowing ù milk api honey: arthạm i will ul yā up antar sa murgu ak thee; mu thou art a stiffnecked saĝ: lest i consume thee ša bi way.
u3 when bi ukkin heard these evil tidings, they mourned: u3 nahi lú did put on him ani ornaments.

šè bi ensi had brū prati moses, e abhimukham tad children ak israel, ye are a stiffnecked saĝ: i will prāp up antar bi antarā ak thee ša a moment, tathā consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments tas thee, yad i may know what šè do šè thee.
ca sa children sya israel stripped themselves sya teṣām ornaments by eṣa mount horeb.

ù moses took bi tabernacle, ù pitched idam vinā tad camp, afar off ta bi camp, ù nam idam tad tabernacle ak sa congregation. ù tat ā-gam šè pass, yad every eka yaḥ sought bi ensi du bar prati tad tabernacle ak bi congregation, yad gál ul bi camp.
tathā idam āyā šè pass, when moses vraj bāhya šè bi tabernacle, iri niĝ sa prajā rose up, u3 stood every puruṣa at ani tent door, ù looked after moses, until sa me gone šè eṣa tabernacle.
ù tat prāp šè pass, as moses entered antar bi tabernacle, sa cloudy pillar descended, tathā stood at bi door asya tad tabernacle, ù bi prabhu talked sahita moses.
u3 sakala tad prajā igi bi cloudy pillar stand at eṣa tabernacle door: u3 viśva bi prajā rose up u3 worshipped, every manuṣya ša bi tent door.

tathā eṣa svāmin spake šè moses vadana abhimukham vadana, as a puruṣa speaketh prati tasya friend. u3 ani turned again šè bi camp: but ani servant joshua, bi suta asya nun, a young nara, departed na bāhya sya sa tabernacle.

u3 moses brū prati eṣa prabhu, paś, thou sayest šè me, bring up etat saĝ: ù thou hast na dā me know whom thou wilt send sahita me. yet thou hast brū, i know thee by name, ca thou hast also found grace antar my sight.
now therefore, i pray thee, if i have found grace a thy sight, shew me now thy way, iri i may know thee, ne i may find grace ša thy sight: ù consider tad etat nation is thy ukkin.
api ayam brū, my presence shall gen da thee, ù i will give thee rest.
api sa vac prati him, if thy presence gam mā ù me, carry us ul up hence.

kṛte wherein shall bi bhū known here iri i api thy saĝ have found grace a thy sight? is ne mā ša yad thou goest saha us? ittham shall we me separated, i u3 thy prajā, prabhṛti sarva bi jana iri are par bi vadana asya tad bhūmi.
u3 eṣa ensi e prati moses, i will do etat thing also iri thou hast spoken: arthạm thou hast found grace madhye my sight, api i know thee by name.
u3 bi dug4, i beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

ù sa e, i will nirmā niĝ my goodness pass before thee, api i will proclaim bi name ak eṣa ensi before thee; api will me gracious prati whom i will as gracious, ù will shew mercy on whom i will shew mercy.
api ani vac, thou canst nu dṛś my vadana: kṛte ni shall nu nitadam dṛś me, u3 til.
ù eṣa svāmin brū, behold, atra is a ki by me, ù thou shalt stand par a rock:
ca idam shall gin šè pass, while my glory passeth by, ne i will put thee a a clift sya bi rock, ù will cover thee saha my hand while i pass by:
tathā i will take away mine hand, ù thou shalt lok my back parts: but my vadana shall ul bhū bar.
ca bi svāmin e abhimukham moses, hew thee dvau tables asya stone like prati sa prathama: api i will write ugu these tables bi words iri me madhye bi ādya tables, yaḥ thou brakest.
ù gál ready a bi prātas, api prāp up a bi uṣas šè mount sinai, tathā present thyself tatra šè me ša sa top sya eṣa mount.
u3 na guruš shall prāp up saha thee, neither anujñā any lú gál dṛś throughout šu sa mount; neither dā sa flocks nor herds feed before tad mount.

ca bi hewed min tables ak stone like abhimukham bi 1-kam; ù moses rose up early madhye bi u4-ul-li, ù yā up šè mount sinai, as tad svāmin had commanded him, api took ša ani hand sa dvau tables ak stone.
api bi prabhu descended antar bi cloud, ù stood sahita him tatra, tathā proclaimed bi name sya eṣa lugal.
ca tad en passed by before him, u3 proclaimed, bi prabhu, bi nātha deva, merciful ù gracious, longsuffering, tathā abundant ša goodness tathā truth,

keeping mercy arthạm thousands, forgiving iniquity tathā transgression tathā sin, u3 iri will by nu means clear eṣa guilty; visiting bi iniquity ak eṣa fathers par bi children, u3 ugu bi children's children, prati eṣa tṛtīya u3 prati bi fourth generation.
api moses dim haste, ù bowed tasya head toward bi ki, u3 worshipped.

u3 bi brū, if now i have found grace antar thy sight, o prabhu, dā my svāmin, i pray thee, du among us; arthạm bi is a stiffnecked loka; ù pardon our iniquity u3 our sin, api take us šè thine inheritance.

ca bi vac, behold, i kṛ a covenant: before viśva thy ukkin i will do marvels, such as have ul vṛt done antar viśva bi uraš, nor antar any nation: tathā sarva tad jana among yaḥ thou art shall dṛś tad work sya eṣa svāmin: šè idam is a terrible thing yad i will do sahita thee.
observe thou ne yaḥ i command thee ne ud: behold, i drive bar before thee tad amorite, tathā bi canaanite, ù bi hittite, u3 bi perizzite, tathā bi hivite, tathā bi jebusite.
take heed prati thyself, lest thou vidh a covenant ù tad inhabitants ak eṣa kur whither thou goest, lest ne gál šè a snare ša bi antarā ak thee:
but ye shall destroy teṣām altars, break teṣām images, ù cut down bi-meš groves:
kṛte thou shalt worship nahi other dingir: mu bi svāmin, whose name is jealous, is a jealous deva:
lest thou nirmā a covenant saha sa inhabitants ak sa kalam, ù they yā a whoring after bi-meš gods, ù do sacrifice abhimukham eṣām gods, api prathama mu-ù thee, ca thou eat sya bi sacrifice;
u3 thou take asya bi-meš daughters šè thy ibila, api teṣām daughters è a whoring after bi-meš gods, ca vidh thy ibila vraj a whoring after teṣām gods.
thou shalt gag thee na molten gods.
bi feast sya unleavened bread shalt thou keep. seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as i commanded thee, madhye eṣa time ak sa month abib: arthạm ša sa month abib thou camest è tas egypt.
viśva iri openeth eṣa matrix is mine; ù every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, yad is male.

but tad firstling asya an ass thou shalt redeem da a lamb: ù if thou redeem him mā, then shalt thou break tasya neck. gištug bi firstborn asya thy dumu thou shalt redeem. ù none shall dṛś before me empty.
six days thou shalt work, but on sa seventh ud thou shalt rest: madhye earing time ca antar harvest thou shalt rest.
ù thou shalt observe bi feast asya weeks, ak bi firstfruits asya wheat harvest, ù bi feast sya ingathering at bi year's end.
thrice a sa year shall niĝ your menchildren prakāś before sa lugal īśvara, eṣa dingir ak israel.
arthạm i will cast bahis sa nations before thee, ù enlarge thy borders: neither shall any manuṣya desire thy bhū, when thou shalt yā up šè prakāś before sa ensi thy dingir thrice antar bi year.
thou shalt na offer bi blood ak my sacrifice sahita leaven; neither shall eṣa sacrifice sya bi feast sya sa passover gál left abhimukham bi uṣas.
eṣa 1-kam sya bi firstfruits sya thy kalam thou shalt bring abhimukham tad gṛha sya bi lugal thy ilum. thou shalt ul seethe a kid ša asya mother's milk.
ù bi ensi e šè moses, write thou these words: mu after bi tenor sya these words i have dù a covenant sahita thee ù da israel.
ca sa gál tatra da bi prabhu forty days u3 forty nights; ayam did neither eat bread, nor drink ídim. tathā sa wrote upari bi tables tad words ak bi covenant, tad ten commandments.

api idam prāp prati pass, when moses ā-gam down ta mount sinai ù tad dvau tables sya testimony a moses' hand, when bi du down ta bi mount, iri moses wist nu iri sa skin ak asya igi shone while eṣa talked sahita him.
api when aaron ù niĝ bi children sya israel bar moses, behold, sa skin ak bi igi shone; tathā they vṛt afraid šè ā-gam nigh him.
u3 moses nam prati tān; ca aaron u3 šu sa rulers ak eṣa congregation returned prati him: tathā moses talked da bi-ne.
ù afterward sakala eṣa children sya israel prāp nigh: ù ayam gave tān ša commandment sakala tad tad ensi had spoken ù him madhye mount sinai.
ca till moses had done speaking saha tān, ani put a vail on bi vadana.
but when moses yā a before sa en šè speak da him, ani took bi vail off, until bi prāp bar. api bi ā-gam bar, ù spake šè bi children ak israel ne lú sa bhū commanded.
u3 bi children ak israel paś bi vadana ak moses, ne sa skin sya moses' vadana shone: u3 moses put bi vail šu-ba ani pa again, until eṣa du ša šè speak saha him.
u3 moses saṃgṛh niĝ bi congregation ak sa children sya israel ús, ù brū abhimukham bi-ne, these are bi words ša sa en hath commanded, iri ye should do bi-ne.
six days shall work as done, but on tad seventh u4 ni shall as šè you an holy ahar, a sabbath ak rest prati tad prabhu: whosoever doeth work therein shall vṛt put šè ug7.
ye shall kindle nu fire throughout your habitations upari bi sabbath ahar.
ù moses spake šè šu bi congregation ak bi children sya israel, vac, idam is tad thing lú bi ensi commanded, brū,
take ye tas among you an offering šè tad lugal: whosoever is ak a willing heart, dā him bring idam, an offering ak tad prabhu; gold, u3 silver, ca brass,
u3 blue, tathā purple, ù scarlet, tathā fine linen, api goats' hair,
u3 rams' skins dyed red, ù badgers' skins, api shittim wood,
api oil arthạm tad ud, ù spices arthạm anointing oil, ù šè tad sweet incense,
ù onyx stones, u3 stones šè me set arthạm sa ephod, u3 mu bi breastplate.
u3 every wise hearted among you shall è, tathā vidh sakala ne tad lugal hath commanded;
bi tabernacle, asya tent, ù tasya covering, bi taches, u3 tasya boards, bi bars, ani pillars, u3 tasya sockets,
bi ark, ù eṣa staves thereof, ù bi mercy seat, tathā bi vail ak eṣa covering,
eṣa table, ù bi staves, ca gištug tasya vessels, ù bi shewbread,
tad candlestick also mu sa jyotis, ù tasya furniture, api asya lamps, ù tad oil šè bi bànda,
ca bi incense altar, u3 bi staves, api bi anointing oil, ù bi sweet incense, api eṣa hanging arthạm eṣa door at tad entering antar ak sa tabernacle,
sa altar ak burnt offering, ù ani brasen grate, bi staves, tathā niĝ asya vessels, bi laver api bi foot,
bi hangings ak bi court, ani pillars, ù teṣām sockets, u3 tad hanging šè bi door sya sa court,
bi pins ak bi tabernacle, u3 sa pins ak sa court, ù bi-meš cords,
bi cloths asya service, abhimukham do service antar tad holy šà, bi holy garments šè aaron eṣa priest, ca tad garments ak bi dumu, šè minister madhye bi priest's office.
u3 šu sa congregation ak bi children ak israel departed tas bi presence ak moses.

ca they è, every eka whose heart stirred him up, api every eka whom tasya an-zu kṛ willing, tathā they brought bi lord's offering prati bi work asya eṣa tabernacle ak bi congregation, ca šè viśva bi service, ca mu bi holy garments.

tathā they āyā, both men ù women, as many as as willing hearted, ca brought bracelets, ù earrings, ù rings, ù tablets, sarva jewels sya gold: api every manuṣya tad offered offered an offering sya gold šè bi svāmin.
api every nara, sahita whom as found blue, api purple, ca scarlet, ù fine linen, ù goats' hair, ù red skins ak rams, u3 badgers' skins, brought etān.
every prathama yad did offer an offering ak silver u3 brass brought eṣa lord's offering: api every puruṣa, ù whom as found shittim wood kṛte any work asya bi service, brought bi.
api sarva bi women yad gál wise hearted did spin sahita bi-meš hands, u3 brought ne yaḥ they had spun, both asya blue, api ak purple, tathā ak scarlet, ca ak fine linen.
api sarva bi women whose heart stirred etān up ša wisdom spun goats' hair.
u3 bi rulers brought onyx stones, api stones abhimukham me set, kṛte eṣa ephod, u3 arthạm tad breastplate;
api spice, ù oil arthạm bi jyotis, ù arthạm tad anointing oil, tathā mu bi sweet incense.

eṣa children sya israel brought a willing offering prati tad lugal, every puruṣa ù munus, whose heart nirmā bi-ne willing prati bring mu sarva manner ak work, lú tad svāmin had commanded šè me vidh by bi hand asya moses.
api moses vac šè sa children ak israel, dṛś, bi en hath āhva by name bezaleel sa putra asya uri, bi putra ak hur, asya bi tribe asya judah;
ù bi hath filled him ù sa prāṇa asya deva, a wisdom, antar understanding, ù a knowledge, tathā madhye sarva manner sya workmanship;
ù prati devise curious works, šè work antar gold, api ša silver, u3 antar brass,
tathā ša bi cutting sya stones, šè set bi-ne, u3 madhye carving asya wood, abhimukham dim any manner asya cunning work.
ù eṣa hath put a asya heart yad ayam may teach, both eṣa, u3 aholiab, sa dumu ak ahisamach, asya bi tribe ak dan.

tān hath ani filled ù wisdom ak heart, abhimukham work sarva manner ak work, asya bi engraver, ù sya bi cunning workman, ca ak bi embroiderer, madhye blue, u3 ša purple, madhye scarlet, tathā antar fine linen, u3 ak eṣa weaver, even ak bi-ne tad do any work, api sya those iri devise cunning work.

then wrought bezaleel ù aholiab, u3 every wise hearted nara, ša whom eṣa ensi put wisdom ù understanding šè know how prati work sakala manner asya work šè tad service ak sa sanctuary, according prati sakala tad sa ensi had commanded.

tathā moses nam bezaleel api aholiab, ca every wise hearted puruṣa, madhye whose heart bi prabhu had put wisdom, even every prathama whose heart stirred him up abhimukham ā-gam šè bi work prati do idam:

u3 they received ak moses viśva bi offering, lú tad children ak israel had brought šè eṣa work ak bi service ak bi sanctuary, prati nirmā ne withal. ù they brought yet šè him free offerings every uṣas.
u3 gištug eṣa wise men, tad wrought viśva tad work ak sa sanctuary, ā-gam every manuṣya ta bi work lú they kṛ;
tathā they spake abhimukham moses, e, bi jana bring much more than enough arthạm tad service ak sa work, lú sa ensi commanded prati gag.

api moses gave commandment, tathā they caused tat šè me proclaimed throughout eṣa camp, inim, anujñā neither manuṣya nor strī vidh any more work arthạm tad offering asya bi sanctuary. ittham sa loka me restrained ta bringing.
arthạm bi stuff they had as sufficient mu sarva eṣa work abhimukham nirmā tat, ca too much.
ù every wise hearted nitadam among bi-ne ne wrought tad work sya sa tabernacle kṛ ten curtains sya fine twined linen, tathā blue, u3 purple, u3 scarlet: da cherubims asya cunning work dù ani tān.
sa length ak prathama curtain as twenty tathā eight cubits, api sa breadth ak aš curtain four cubits: tad curtains me šu asya aš size.
ù ani coupled eṣa five curtains prathama prati another: api bi other five curtains ani coupled diš šè another.
tathā bi dù loops sya blue on bi edge ak prathama curtain prabhṛti bi selvedge madhye bi coupling: likewise sa kṛ a tad uttermost side ak another curtain, antar sa coupling asya tad dvi.
fifty loops gag sa ša aš curtain, ca fifty loops gag ayam a bi edge ak sa curtain lú as madhye bi coupling asya bi dvi: tad loops held diš curtain prati another.
ca ani dù fifty taches sya gold, ù coupled tad curtains prathama prati another sahita bi taches: ga-nam ne became eka tabernacle.
u3 sa vidh curtains asya goats' hair šè bi tent over eṣa tabernacle: eleven curtains sa vidh bi-ne.
tad length sya aš curtain as thirty cubits, u3 four cubits bhū eṣa breadth asya eka curtain: bi eleven curtains vṛt ak diš size.
u3 ayam coupled five curtains by themselves, ca six curtains by themselves.
api sa vidh fifty loops šu-ba eṣa uttermost edge ak bi curtain a bi coupling, tathā fifty loops kṛ eṣa par bi edge ak sa curtain yaḥ coupleth bi dvitīya.
api ayam gag fifty taches asya brass šè couple bi tent saṃyuktam, yad tat might me eka.
ca ani nirmā a covering šè sa tent ak rams' skins dyed red, ù a covering ak badgers' skins ugu iri.
u3 sa gag boards kṛte tad tabernacle ak shittim wood, standing up.
bi length ak a board me ten cubits, api bi breadth asya a board diš cubit ù a half.
aš board had dvau tenons, equally distant aš tas another: thus did ayam vidh arthạm viśva eṣa boards sya sa tabernacle.
tathā sa vidh boards kṛte sa tabernacle; twenty boards šè sa south side southward:
ca forty sockets ak silver eṣa kṛ nīce bi twenty boards; dvau sockets ki-ta eka board šè tasya min tenons, ca min sockets adhas another board arthạm ani min tenons.
ca mu tad other side ak eṣa tabernacle, yaḥ is toward sa north corner, ayam gag twenty boards,
api eṣām forty sockets ak silver; dvi sockets kur diš board, ca dvi sockets adhas another board.
tathā kṛte eṣa sides sya bi tabernacle westward bi dim six boards.
u3 dvau boards kṛ ani arthạm bi corners ak bi tabernacle antar bi min sides.
api they gál coupled beneath, api coupled niĝin at sa head thereof, abhimukham diš ring: thus sa did abhimukham both ak bi-ne ša both tad corners.
ù ni vṛt eight boards; ù bi-meš sockets vṛt sixteen sockets asya silver, nīce every board min sockets.
ù ani nirmā bars asya shittim wood; five kṛte bi boards ak bi diš side asya eṣa tabernacle,
u3 five bars šè bi boards asya bi other side ak tad tabernacle, u3 five bars šè sa boards ak bi tabernacle arthạm bi sides westward.
ù ayam vidh bi middle bar prati shoot through tad boards prabhṛti eṣa eka end šè bi other.
ca sa overlaid eṣa boards sahita gold, api dù teṣām rings sya gold abhimukham me places mu sa bars, tathā overlaid bi bars da gold.
ca ani gag a vail sya blue, u3 purple, u3 scarlet, tathā fine twined linen: sahita cherubims dim sa idam sya cunning work.
u3 bi vidh thereunto four pillars sya shittim wood, u3 overlaid bi-ne sahita gold: teṣām hooks me ak gold; ù ayam cast mu bi-ne four sockets ak silver.
u3 eṣa vidh an hanging kṛte bi tabernacle door ak blue, u3 purple, ca scarlet, u3 fine twined linen, ak needlework;
ù tad five pillars asya idam da bi-meš hooks: api sa overlaid teṣām chapiters u3 bi-meš fillets ù gold: but bi-meš five sockets as ak brass.
api bezaleel nirmā bi ark asya shittim wood: dvi cubits ù a half bhū bi length asya tat, u3 a cubit ù a half sa breadth ak bi, tathā a cubit api a half tad height ak idam:
ù ani overlaid idam sahita pure gold within api rahita, u3 dù a crown asya gold šè idam round about.
api sa cast kṛte tat four rings asya gold, abhimukham me set by bi four corners ak tat; even min rings upari bi aš side ak bi, u3 min rings ugu sa other side sya bi.
ù eṣa dim staves ak shittim wood, ù overlaid bi-ne sahita gold.
u3 bi put eṣa staves praviśya bi rings by eṣa sides asya sa ark, abhimukham bear sa ark.
ca ayam dim bi mercy seat ak pure gold: dvi cubits u3 a half bhū bi length thereof, ù diš cubit u3 a half bi breadth thereof.
tathā ani gag min cherubims sya gold, beaten bāhya ak diš piece dim sa bi-ne, on tad min ends sya tad mercy seat;
diš cherub on tad end on idam side, u3 another cherub on bi other end on iri side: bar ak eṣa mercy seat gag ayam bi cherubims on sa min ends thereof.
u3 tad cherubims spread bahis bi-meš wings on high, u3 covered sahita teṣām wings over sa mercy seat, sahita eṣām faces aš abhimukham another; even šè bi mercy seatward as tad faces ak bi cherubims.
tathā ani vidh sa table asya shittim wood: dvi cubits vṛt bi length thereof, ca a cubit bi breadth thereof, ca a cubit api a half sa height thereof:
tathā sa overlaid bi ù pure gold, u3 dù thereunto a crown ak gold round about.
also bi kṛ thereunto a border ak an handbreadth round about; ù vidh a crown ak gold šè sa border thereof round about.
tathā bi cast mu ne four rings sya gold, api put eṣa rings ugu bi four corners ne me antar bi four feet thereof.
over against bi border bhū bi rings, bi places mu bi staves šè bear sa table.
api sa nirmā bi staves ak shittim wood, api overlaid bi-ne ù gold, šè bear bi table.
ca bi dù bi vessels yad vṛt šu-ba bi table, asya dishes, ca tasya spoons, ù asya bowls, ù asya covers abhimukham cover withal, ak pure gold.
api ani vidh bi candlestick ak pure gold: ak beaten work nirmā bi tad candlestick; bi shaft, ca bi branch, bi bowls, tasya knops, tathā bi flowers, gál sya eṣa same:
u3 six branches going bahis ak bi sides thereof; three branches asya bi candlestick è ak sa prathama side thereof, tathā three branches ak bi candlestick è ak eṣa other side thereof:

three bowls dù after bi fashion ak almonds a diš branch, a knop u3 a flower; ù three bowls gag like almonds ša another branch, a knop ca a flower: ga-nam throughout bi six branches going bahis asya eṣa candlestick.
ca antar bi candlestick me four bowls dù like almonds, tasya knops, api ani flowers:
ù a knop adhas min branches sya bi same, ù a knop adhas dvau branches ak bi same, tathā a knop nīce dvi branches sya bi same, according šè eṣa six branches going bar ak ne.
bi-meš knops tathā bi-meš branches me ak eṣa same: gištug asya idam me diš beaten work ak pure gold.
u3 ani kṛ asya seven lamps, api tasya snuffers, api tasya snuffdishes, sya pure gold.
sya a talent ak pure gold gag ani tat, ù sarva bi vessels thereof.
ù eṣa dù bi incense altar ak shittim wood: sa length ak bi me a cubit, u3 tad breadth ak idam a cubit; ne gál foursquare; tathā dvau cubits gál eṣa height ak ne; tad horns thereof bhū sya bi same.
tathā bi overlaid idam saha pure gold, both tad top ak tat, ù sa sides thereof round about, u3 tad horns asya tat: also eṣa dù prati ne a crown asya gold round about.
tathā bi dim dvi rings sya gold kṛte bi kur tad crown thereof, by bi min corners ak idam, ugu tad dvi sides thereof, šè gál places šè bi staves prati bear tat withal.
ca bi nirmā tad staves sya shittim wood, api overlaid bi-ne da gold.
ù bi dim eṣa holy anointing oil, tathā bi pure incense sya sweet spices, according šè bi work ak bi apothecary.
ù sa dim bi altar ak burnt offering ak shittim wood: five cubits gál bi length thereof, ù five cubits bi breadth thereof; ne vṛt foursquare; ù three cubits eṣa height thereof.
ù ani vidh tad horns thereof on tad four corners ak bi; tad horns thereof as sya tad same: tathā bi overlaid ne ù brass.
api ani nirmā šu bi vessels ak tad altar, bi pots, u3 bi shovels, tathā sa basons, ù tad fleshhooks, api bi firepans: viśva bi vessels thereof kṛ bi sya brass.
tathā ani vidh mu tad altar a brasen grate asya network nīce bi compass thereof beneath prati sa šà ak bi.
ca sa cast four rings mu eṣa four ends sya bi grate sya brass, prati as places arthạm sa staves.
ca eṣa gag bi staves ak shittim wood, ù overlaid bi-ne da brass.
tathā bi put bi staves praviśya bi rings on bi sides sya sa altar, prati bear ne withal; sa gag tad altar hollow ù boards.
ù bi gag bi laver ak brass, ca eṣa foot ak ne ak brass, sya eṣa lookingglasses asya bi women assembling, ša assembled at bi door asya tad tabernacle ak bi congregation.
u3 ayam nirmā bi court: on tad south side southward eṣa hangings ak sa court gál asya fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
bi-meš pillars gál twenty, ca eṣām brasen sockets twenty; bi hooks ak bi pillars api teṣām fillets me ak silver.
u3 kṛte tad north side bi hangings gál an hundred cubits, eṣām pillars gál twenty, ù eṣām sockets ak brass twenty; bi hooks ak bi pillars api teṣām fillets asya silver.
tathā šè bi west side me hangings asya fifty cubits, bi-meš pillars ten, api bi-meš sockets ten; bi hooks sya bi pillars ù bi-meš fillets asya silver.
u3 arthạm bi east side eastward fifty cubits.
sa hangings asya bi aš side asya sa gate gál fifteen cubits; bi-meš pillars three, api bi-meš sockets three.
ù mu eṣa other side ak bi court gate, on idam hand api tad hand, gál hangings sya fifteen cubits; bi-meš pillars three, ù bi-meš sockets three.
niĝ eṣa hangings sya bi court round about gál ak fine twined linen.

tathā tad sockets arthạm eṣa pillars vṛt ak brass; tad hooks ak bi pillars ù bi-meš fillets asya silver; ù bi overlaying sya teṣām chapiters asya silver; tathā gištug bi pillars asya bi court vṛt filleted saha silver.

u3 sa hanging mu tad gate ak bi court gál needlework, asya blue, u3 purple, tathā scarlet, u3 fine twined linen: tathā twenty cubits bhū bi length, api bi height antar bi breadth me five cubits, answerable šè sa hangings ak bi court.
ca teṣām pillars me four, ù bi-meš sockets sya brass four; bi-meš hooks ak silver, u3 bi overlaying sya bi-meš chapiters tathā bi-meš fillets asya silver.
ù šu bi pins ak eṣa tabernacle, api ak bi court round about, bhū asya brass.

bi is bi sum sya bi tabernacle, even asya bi tabernacle ak testimony, as tat me counted, according šè bi commandment asya moses, mu eṣa service sya bi levites, by bi hand asya ithamar, dumu prati aaron bi priest.
tathā bezaleel eṣa ātmaja ak uri, bi dumu sya hur, asya bi tribe sya judah, gag gištug tad bi prabhu commanded moses.
api da him me aholiab, ibila sya ahisamach, sya tad tribe ak dan, an engraver, u3 a cunning workman, ù an embroiderer antar blue, api antar purple, ù antar scarlet, u3 fine linen.

niĝ bi gold tad vṛt occupied šè eṣa work ša sarva tad work asya tad holy šà, even tad gold ak bi offering, gál twenty u3 nine talents, api seven hundred ca thirty shekels, after tad shekel sya bi sanctuary.
u3 sa silver ak bi-ne tad me numbered sya bi congregation vṛt an hundred talents, ca a thousand seven hundred api threescore ù fifteen shekels, after bi shekel ak sa sanctuary:

a bekah kṛte every lú, yad is, half a shekel, after bi shekel ak sa sanctuary, šè every diš yad gen abhimukham gál numbered, prabhṛti twenty years old ù upward, arthạm six hundred thousand ca three thousand api five hundred u3 fifty men.
ca asya eṣa hundred talents ak silver me cast bi sockets asya bi sanctuary, api bi sockets asya tad vail; an hundred sockets ak eṣa hundred talents, a talent kṛte a socket.
tathā asya sa thousand seven hundred seventy api five shekels eṣa gag hooks arthạm bi pillars, api overlaid bi-meš chapiters, api filleted bi-ne.
ù eṣa brass sya bi offering me seventy talents, u3 dvau thousand tathā four hundred shekels.
tathā therewith sa vidh bi sockets abhimukham eṣa door ak bi tabernacle sya bi congregation, tathā eṣa brasen altar, u3 sa brasen grate kṛte tat, api gištug tad vessels ak bi altar,
tathā bi sockets asya bi court round about, ca bi sockets ak tad court gate, u3 viśva sa pins asya eṣa tabernacle, api gištug bi pins ak tad court round about.
ca ak bi blue, api purple, ù scarlet, they vidh cloths asya service, šè do service madhye bi holy ki, tathā gag sa holy garments arthạm aaron; as tad prabhu commanded moses.
ù eṣa gag bi ephod ak gold, blue, u3 purple, ca scarlet, api fine twined linen.
ù they did beat sa gold praviśya thin plates, u3 cut idam antar wires, prati work tat a tad blue, tathā madhye bi purple, tathā ša tad scarlet, ù a sa fine linen, da cunning work.
they gag shoulderpieces arthạm ne, šè couple tat saha: by bi min edges gál ne coupled ús.
u3 bi curious girdle ak asya ephod, yad bhū upari idam, as ak bi same, according prati tad work thereof; asya gold, blue, ù purple, ù scarlet, ca fine twined linen; as bi prabhu commanded moses.
api they wrought onyx stones inclosed madhye ouches asya gold, graven, as signets are graven, sahita sa names ak sa children ak israel.
ca sa put bi-ne on bi shoulders asya bi ephod, yad they should as stones šè a memorial prati bi children ak israel; as bi lugal commanded moses.
ù ani nirmā eṣa breastplate ak cunning work, like bi work sya bi ephod; asya gold, blue, tathā purple, tathā scarlet, tathā fine twined linen.
tat gál foursquare; they kṛ tad breastplate double: a span gál tad length thereof, tathā a span bi breadth thereof, being doubled.
u3 they set antar bi four rows sya stones: sa prathama row bhū a sardius, a topaz, ù a carbuncle: ne gál bi imin row.
api sa dvi row, an emerald, a sapphire, ca a diamond.
api tad tṛtīya row, a ligure, an agate, api an amethyst.
tathā bi fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, ù a jasper: they gál inclosed ša ouches ak gold antar eṣām inclosings.
